scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
This..and..that...
All guys...are distrustful.
Makes me a braggart.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
这个...那个...
所有人...都不信任我。
这让我像个吹牛大王。

scripts.text: Do you have a problem?
scripts.translation: 你有问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I haven't seen you before.
Are you a traveler?
If so, then you may have
seen many marvelous things
from near and far.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
我以前没见过你。
你是旅行者吗？
如果是的话，那你一定
见过远近许多奇妙的景象。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I'm sure you'll probably
be interested in my story.
All the villagers are blockheads,
so they treat me like an idiot.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
我想你大概会对我的故事感兴趣。
村民们都是些笨蛋，
他们把我当傻子看待。

scripts.text: I'm not interested in any story.
scripts.translation: 我对任何故事都不感兴趣。

scripts.text: Tell me.
scripts.translation: 告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Indeed... You are not interested...
That's ok.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
确实...你并不感兴趣...
没关系。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
If you change your mind,
you can talk to me whenever.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
如果你改变主意了，
随时都可以来找我。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Good, I have been thinking that
I would tell you this story from the start.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
很好，我本来就想
从头开始给你讲这个故事。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
You seem to have spent
only a few days here.
Have you ever heard
about The Moving Island?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
你似乎只在这里待了几天。
你听说过“移动之岛”吗？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
In Moscovia,
a story is handed down
from the ancients, like legends.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
在莫斯科比亚，
有一个故事从古代流传下来，
就像传说一样。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
It is said that
there is an island
which sometimes moves,
not far out at sea.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
据说在离海岸不远的地方，
有一座岛屿，
它有时会移动。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
But, nobody has seen
the island before.
So, few people have
believed the legend.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
但是，没有人见过
那座岛屿。
所以，很少有人
相信这个传说。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Actually, I thought that
it might be a kind of
old story... nothing more.
But then... I saw...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
实际上，我以为那
可能只是某种
古老的故事...仅此而已。
但后来...我看见了...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Actually, I thought that
it might be a kind of
old story... nothing more.
But then... I saw...
The Moving Island!!!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
实际上，我以为那
可能只是某种
古老的故事...仅此而已。
但后来...我看见了...
移动之岛！！！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Surprised? Right...
It is so surprising.
Frankly, you don't believe
any of this story either.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
惊讶吗？没错...
确实很令人惊讶。
坦白说，你也不相信
这个故事的任何部分。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I saw the island
from the middle of
the village's south shore.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
我是从村庄南岸的
中间位置看到那座岛的。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
At first, I doubted my eyes.
I have never heard that that island
really existed here, even though I
have lived here all my life!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
起初，我怀疑自己的眼睛。
虽然我在这里生活了一辈子，
但我从未听说过那座岛
真的存在！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I tried to go up
to look at it from
higher ground, but
the island receded
and disappeared...
back to the sea.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
我试图爬上去，
从高处观察它，但
岛屿退去了，
消失了...
回到了大海中。

scripts.text: The island doesn't appear anymore?
scripts.translation: 岛屿不再出现了吗？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
If it does,
one might just think
that they've looked
at an apparition.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
如果是这样，
人们或许会觉得
自己看到了
海市蜃楼。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
But a few nights ago...
Finally, the island appeared
in front of me again,
while I was driving my ship to go home.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
但就在几天前...
当我驾船回家时，
那座岛终于再次
出现在我面前。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
At that time, I tried to
get near the island again,
slowly, but it disappeared...
beyond the sea once more.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
当时，我试图
再次靠近那座岛，
慢慢地，但它又消失了...
再次隐入大海深处。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
It was then, I couldn't help
to finally believe
in the existence of
The Moving Island!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
就在那一刻，我不得不
最终相信
移动岛的存在！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Surely, this must be
a great discovery!
Don't you think??
Doesn't your heart shout out in
hopes of adventuring out to the island?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
这绝对是一个
伟大的发现！
你不觉得吗？
难道你的心中
没有涌起想要去岛上冒险的渴望吗？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
I haven't given up yet!
Certainly, it'll appear again
right in front of us!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
我还没有放弃！
它一定会再次
出现在我们面前！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
And on that day,
I'll definitely go up to that
island... and verify it with my own eyes!
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
到那一天，
我一定会登上那座岛...
并亲眼验证它的存在！

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Clearly, I want to prove
the existence of that island to everyone...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
显然，我想向所有人
证明那座岛的存在...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
If the island appears again,
I should certify its identity.
Would you like to try it?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
如果那座岛再次出现，
我应该确认它的身份。
你想试试吗？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
The best way to find the
island is by direct contact
with a ship in the sea.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
找到那座岛的最佳方式
是直接与海上的船只
取得联系。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Me?
Of course I have a ship.
I am a fisherman after all...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
我？
当然我有船。
毕竟我是个渔夫...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Ah, you do? You need...
a ship? Hm...too bad.
I can't lend my ship to you...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
啊，是吗？你需要...
一艘船？嗯...真遗憾。
我不能把我的船借给你...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
But maybe Mr. Ibanoff
can lend his ship to you
He likes going around
adventuring like me.
He seems to enjoy his youth...
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
但也许伊巴诺夫先生
可以把他的船借给你。
他喜欢像我一样四处冒险。
他似乎很享受他的青春...

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Mr. Ibanoff also traveled and
adventured all over the world
like you, so he might understand
your sentiments well.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
伊巴诺夫先生也像你一样
周游世界并冒险，
所以他可能很理解
你的心情。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
If you want to find the island
by ship, go to Mr. Ibanoff
and ask for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
如果你想坐船找到那座岛，
去找伊巴诺夫先生
请求他的帮助吧。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Are you serious? Did you say
you've found The Moving Island?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
你是认真的吗？你说你
找到了移动岛？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
The legend is true!!
I was right, wasn't I?
You must be a great adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
传说是真的！！
我是对的，不是吗？
你一定是一位伟大的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Welcome to Moscovia.
What's your impression thus far?
Looks gorgeous, huh?
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
欢迎来到莫斯科比亚。
你目前的印象如何？
看起来很壮观，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Berbayeff]
Most travelers and strangers
like our village.
I want you to visit places here and
there. You'll probably love this town.
scripts.translation:
[贝尔巴耶夫]
大多数旅行者和陌生人
都喜欢我们的村庄。
我想让你去这里那里逛逛。
你大概会喜欢这个城镇的。

scripts.text:
[Charabel Schedule]
NOTICE, due to the varying
tides here in Moscovia,
the charabel can only
depart when the tide is low.
scripts.translation:
[查拉贝尔日程]
告示：由于莫斯科比亚的潮汐变化，
查拉贝尔船只能在低潮时出发。

scripts.text:
[Charabel Schedule]
The Charabel can depart
between the following times:
^0000FF12:00am PST^000000 to ^0000FF3:00am PST
^0000FF6:00am PST^000000 to ^0000FF9:00am PST
^0000FF12:00pm PST^000000 to ^0000FF3:00pm PST
^0000FF6:00pm PST^000000 to ^0000FF9:00pm PST
scripts.translation:
[查拉贝尔日程]
查拉贝尔船可在以下时间出发：
^0000FF上午12:00 PST^000000 至 ^0000FF上午3:00 PST
^0000FF上午6:00 PST^000000 至 ^0000FF上午9:00 PST
^0000FF下午12:00 PST^000000 至 ^0000FF下午3:00 PST
^0000FF下午6:00 PST^000000 至 ^0000FF下午9:00 PST

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You are also an adventurer from another province. I also was a great adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你也是来自其他地区的冒险者。我也曾是一位伟大的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Uf...I just want to be 20 years younger, so I can travel here and there with invigorating youth such as you... Time is an enemy. Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
唉...我真希望能年轻20岁，这样就能像你们这些充满活力的年轻人一样四处旅行了...时间真是敌人啊。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. Are you Mr. Ibanoff?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。请问是伊巴诺夫先生吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Yes. I am Mr. Ibanoff.
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
是的，我就是伊巴诺夫先生。
有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Tell me an adventure story.
scripts.translation: 给我讲个冒险故事。

scripts.text: Lend me your ship.
scripts.translation: 借你的船用一下。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You are an adventurer, right?
You come from a strange land?
Well, well, well...
You are welcome here.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你是一位冒险者，对吧？
你来自一个陌生的地方？
哎呀，哎呀...
欢迎你来这里。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When I adventured around
Rune-Midgarts, maybe it was
well before you were born.
Ah... I miss those days...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
当我在卢恩·米德加兹冒险的时候，也许那还是你出生前很久的事。
啊...我怀念那些日子...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Now, I'm so tired;
my body and my heart.
I get reminded of fond
memories just by looking at the sea...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
现在，我太累了；
身心俱疲。
只要看着大海，就会想起那些美好的回忆...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Um... Stories...
What to talk about first?
Right, I'll talk about that time I
fought against a huge flock of Porings...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嗯...故事...
先讲哪个好呢？
对了，我就讲讲那次我和一大群波利战斗的经历吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hahaha...

[Mr. Ibanoff]
You'll be happy that you
listened to the adventure story.
Well, well, well...
When I was 24 years old...
My colleagues and I were passing by
a forest near Payon...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
听了这个冒险故事，你一定会很高兴的。
哎呀，哎呀...
在我24岁的时候...
我和同事们路过斐扬附近的一片森林...

scripts.text: when...
and....
then.....
Finally......

[Mr. Ibanoff]
I did a very good
job in the fight, so
my colleagues and I were
able to get back safely.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
在那场战斗中我表现出色，
所以我和同事们都能安全地回来了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What did you think?
Next... Let's talk about
the haunting of a Goblin mob...!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你觉得怎么样？
接下来...让我们聊聊刺刀哥布灵群出没的故事吧...！

scripts.text: I'll listen next time...
scripts.translation: 下次再听吧...

scripts.text: Interesting. Keep talking.
scripts.translation: 有意思。继续说。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If not...Ooo, I can just
keep going and going...
No? Too bad... Hehe...
Let's talk next time.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
如果不听的话...噢哦，我简直可以一直说下去...
不？太可惜了...嘿嘿...
下次再聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Yeah? Ohohoh... my friend,
we are in sync with each other...!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
是吗？噢哦哦...我的朋友，
我们真是心有灵犀啊...！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Ok, this time I'll talk
about the bloody fight at the
haunting of a Goblin mob...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
好吧，这次我要讲讲
刺刀哥布灵群出没时那场血腥的战斗...

scripts.text: You see...
scripts.translation: 你看...

scripts.text: and....
also.....
Lastly......

[Mr. Ibanoff]
So, the day's great bloody
fight was over like that...
Ohwee...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
就这样，那天那场伟大的血腥战斗结束了...
噢喂...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hah! You are the first
to listen carefully to
my stories, for a long time.
Feels so good...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哈哈！你是很久以来
第一个认真听我讲故事的人。
感觉真好...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You absolutely have talent,
as a great adventurer.
You can become a good friend to me.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你绝对有天赋，
作为一名伟大的冒险者。
你可以成为我的好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Next time, we talk about your
adventure story... eh? ~
If you ever need anything,
come talk to me whenever, hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
下次，我们聊聊你的
冒险故事...嗯？~
如果你需要任何帮助，
随时来找我，哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Ah! The good listener!
What will you do if you
borrow my ship? I wonder...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
啊！这位善于倾听的朋友！
如果你借我的船，你会做什么呢？我很好奇...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm going to adventure out
to sea, to find a moving
island which has brought
many a legend to this neighboring village.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要出海冒险，
去寻找一座移动岛屿，
它给这个邻近的村庄
带来了许多传说。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The Moving Island?
I have never seen that really...
You are young! Hawhawhaw!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
移动岛屿？
我从未真正见过它...
你还年轻啊！哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I hope that you find
the island without fail,
and that you bring back
surprising news to us!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我希望你能顺利找到那座岛屿，
并给我们带回令人惊讶的消息！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Let it be so!
First, I should check
the state of the ship...
You have some work to do,
if you want to help me.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
那就这么定了！
首先，我应该检查一下船的状态...
如果你想帮我，
你还有些工作要做。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
She has not floated
for a long time,
so we should check
and repair the parts
that power her up.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
它已经很久没有浮起来了，
所以我们应该检查并修复
那些驱动它的部件。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Preparing the tools for repairs, in
this place, takes several days...
if you can possibly prepare them.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
在这里准备维修工具
需要几天时间...
如果你能准备的话。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The materials needed are:
^0000FFStrange Steel Piece 10, Rusty Screw 10, Flexible Tube 5, Jubilee 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
需要的材料是：
^0000FF魔幻拉链 10, 生锈的螺丝 10, 软管 5, Jubilee 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When you've prepared all the
materials, bring them to me. I'll
repair the ship.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
当你准备好所有材料后，
把它们带给我。我会修复这艘船。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You want to borrow
my ship so spontaneously??
I don't even know you!!
You are more rude than you look.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你竟然这么随意地
想借我的船？
我甚至都不认识你！！
你比看起来还要无礼。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I don't know, how you know
that I have a ship...
Anyway, I can't lend my ship
willingly to strangers.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我不知道你是怎么知道
我有船的...
总之，我不能
心甘情愿地把船借给陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Did you bring all the materials?
If we have all the materials,
we can prepare for departure!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你带齐所有材料了吗？
如果材料都齐了，
我们就可以准备出发了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh! You got the all materials.
It's enough.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哦！你带齐了所有材料。
足够了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Okay, we are at the ready.
When would you like to depart?
I'll say one thing...
It's difficult to keep this
ship afloat after the sun has set.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
好的，我们准备好了。
你想什么时候出发？
我说一句...
太阳落山后，
很难让这艘船保持漂浮。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
In these neighboring waters,
there are many raging waves.
After the sun sets, the tide does
not get any easier... even for an
expert seaman.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
在这些附近的海域，
有很多汹涌的波浪。
太阳落山后，潮汐
并不会变温和...即使是
经验丰富的水手也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Remember, the poor condition of
this ship also factors when
attempting to plow through the
raging waves.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
记住，这艘船糟糕的状况
也是试图穿越
汹涌波浪时的一个因素。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If you are ready to depart, tell
me, and we can check the tides.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
如果你准备好出发了，告诉我，
我们可以查看潮汐。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
These materials are insufficient.
Perhaps you forgot some of them?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
这些材料不够。
也许你忘了其中一些？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The materials needed are:
^0000FFStrange Steel Piece 10, Rusty Screw 10, Flexible Tube 5, Jubilee 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
需要的材料是：
^0000FF魔幻拉链 10, 生锈的螺丝 10, 软管 5, Jubilee 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh. Are you ready to depart?
Good, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哦。你准备好出发了吗？
很好，让我们看看...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hmm. It's not a bad time.
We should hurry up
while the tides are low.
The ship is prepared already
at a dock nearby, so we can depart
right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嗯。时间还不错。
趁潮汐低的时候
我们应该快点。
船已经在附近的码头
准备好了，我们可以
立刻出发。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
That last sailing was tough...
But, all adventures
are like that...
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
上次航行很艰难...
但是，所有的冒险
都是这样的...
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If you keep a mind to
depart again... tell me
and we can check the tides.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
如果你打算
再次出发...告诉我，
我们可以查看潮汐。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Will you depart?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你要出发了吗？

scripts.text: I'm not ready.
scripts.translation: 我还没准备好

scripts.text: Let's go.
scripts.translation: 我们走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When you are ready to depart, tell me.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
当你准备好出发时，告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hmm. It's not a bad time.
We should hurry up
while the tides are low.
The ship is prepared already
at a dock nearby, so we can depart
right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嗯。时间还不错。
趁潮汐低的时候
我们应该快点。
船已经在附近的码头
准备好了，我们可以
立刻出发。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey you... You are alive!
When you were swept away by the
waves, I thought that was the last
I would ever see of you!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嘿...你还活着！
当你被海浪卷走时，
我以为那是
我最后一次见到你了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Anyway, where were you all this time?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
总之，你这段时间都在哪里？

scripts.text: Explain the whole story.
scripts.translation: 解释整个故事

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh... that's really marvelous.
Well I never...
The island truly exists...?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哦...那真是太神奇了。
哎呀...
那个岛真的存在...？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What's more...
The island is not an island?!?
It's a gigantic whale???
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
更令人惊讶的是...
那个岛根本不是岛？！？
它是一头巨大的鲸鱼？？？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
And trees grow... and water
streams... along the whale's
back!!?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
而且鲸鱼的背上
还长着树木...
流淌着溪流...！！？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
That's unbelievable!
The most marvelous incident I have
ever heard in my lifetime!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
这简直难以置信！
是我有生以来
听过的最不可思议的事情！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Also, I am surprised at the
presence of an aged person on Whale
Island!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
另外，我也很惊讶
鲸鱼岛上竟然有一位长者！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
He must be a man strong in
spirit... with experience and high
discipline.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
他一定是一位
精神强大、经验丰富
且自律极高的人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The story of the island has
advanced enough until this part.
Why don't you announce your
findings to our dearest Csar
and receive aid to find Whale
Island?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
关于这座岛的故事
到这里已经足够完整了。
何不向我们要好的凯撒大人
汇报您的发现，
并请求援助以寻找鲸鱼岛呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Our dear Csar likes it very
much to hear stories about
valuable things, so if he
listens to your story, he may give
you a prize...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我们要好的凯撒大人
非常喜欢听关于珍贵事物的故事，
所以如果您讲述这个故事，
他可能会给您奖励...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
And if you have any plans to go
back to the island, I want to go
together with you! Eh? Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
如果您有再次前往该岛的计划，
我想和您一起去！啊？哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If our dear Csar listens to this
kind of story, he would find it a
pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
如果我们要好的凯撒大人
听到这样的故事，
他会感到很高兴的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
He might even give you a prize...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
他甚至可能会给您奖励...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hm. Our dear Csar requested
evidence of the whale island?...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嗯。我们要好的凯撒大人
要求提供鲸鱼岛存在的证据？...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
That may prove a little
difficult...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
这可能会有一点困难...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Do you have a guarantee that you
can find Whale Island again?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
您有把握能再次找到鲸鱼岛吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I think you won't give up.
How about if we depart
once more, and I will gladly help
you find Whale Island!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我想您不会放弃的。
不如我们再出发一次，
我很乐意帮助您寻找鲸鱼岛！

scripts.text: Try again to find Whale Island.
scripts.translation: 再次尝试寻找鲸鱼岛

scripts.text: Give up.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
That does it! I expected it.
I knew you weren't the type to give up an adventure!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
就是这样！我早就料到了。
我就知道您不是那种会放弃冒险的人！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Again, let's get the ship ready and sail before the sun sets!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
再次出发吧，让我们准备好船，在日落前起航！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I see...
Even though you like adventure,
it might be impossible to find
Whale Island again...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我明白了...
虽然您喜欢冒险，
但可能无法再次找到鲸鱼岛...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If you change your mind,
anytime, come tell me.
Frankly, I would love to see you
prove the existence of Whale Island
to our dear Csar.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
如果您改变主意，
随时来告诉我。
说实话，我很想看到您
向我们要好的凯撒大人证明鲸鱼岛的存在。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh! Are you ready to depart?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哦！您准备好出发了吗？

scripts.text: I'm not ready.
scripts.translation: 我还没准备好

scripts.text: Let's go.
scripts.translation: 我们走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When you are ready to depart, tell me.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
当你准备好出发时，告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hmm. It's not a bad time.
We should hurry up
while the tides are low.
The ship is prepared already
at a dock nearby, so we can depart
right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嗯。时间还不错。
趁潮汐低的时候
我们应该快点。
船已经在附近的码头
准备好了，我们可以
立刻出发。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What a surprise!!
Where have you been??
I was worried that you had
disappeared forever!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
真是吓死我了！！
你跑哪里去了？？
我还以为你彻底消失了呢！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I don't care... Wherever you have
been, it's very good to see you
again.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我才不在乎...不管你去哪里了，
能再次见到你真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I can guess you'd like to go to
Whale Island once again...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我猜你大概又想再去一次鲸鱼岛吧...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hmm. It's not a bad time.
We should hurry up
while the tides are low.
The ship is prepared already
at a dock nearby, so we can depart
right away.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嗯。时间还不错。
趁潮汐低的时候
我们应该快点。
船已经在附近的码头
准备好了，我们可以
立刻出发。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh. You came back!
So, how did you do?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哦。你回来了！
那么，结果怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You say...
If you bring the materials, the old
man makes the instrument...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你是说...
如果你带材料过去，那位老人就会制作乐器...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
And he promised that he won't move
the island until you go back
again...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
而且他承诺，在你再次回来之前，
他不会移动岛屿...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I see. I remember the exact
directions. Let's leave
immediately, as soon as you are
ready.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
明白了。我记得确切的方向。
等你准备好了，我们立刻出发。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh. Did you get all the
materials you needed?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哦。你拿到所有需要的材料了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If so, do you want to go now?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
如果是的话，你想现在出发吗？

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 还没有准备好。

scripts.text: Let's go.
scripts.translation: 我们走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I see. I will wait.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
明白了。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Ok, let's go!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
好，我们走！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Finally, everything has ended
successfully. With this, I add 1
more page to my... no, OUR adventure story!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
终于，一切圆满结束。至此，我在...不，我们的冒险故事中又添了一页！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Someday, I want to have another
chance to have another fantastic
adventure with a person like you!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
总有一天，我希望还能有机会和你这样的人物一起经历一次精彩的冒险！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I heard that you played a great
performance, with the instrument
from Whale Island, at the Imperial
Palace. Eh? You must have quite the talent!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我听说你在皇宫里用鲸鱼岛的乐器演奏了一场精彩的演出。咦？你一定很有天赋吧！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Finally, everything has ended
successfully. With this, I add 1
more page to my... no, OUR adventure story!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
终于，一切圆满结束。至此，我在...不，我们的冒险故事中又添了一页！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Someday, I want to have another
chance to have another fantastic
adventure with a person like you!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
总有一天，我希望还能有机会和你这样的人物一起经历一次精彩的冒险！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What's going on?
You should ride a ship now? Let's ready to leave hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
怎么回事？
你现在应该上船了？我们快点准备出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What's going on?
You should ride a ship now? Let's ready to leave hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
怎么回事？
你现在应该上船了？我们快点准备出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Gee. The tide is too high.
It's too dangerous to depart
right now because of the waves
getting too rugged.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哎呀。潮水涨得太高了。
现在海浪太汹涌，出发太危险了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
When the sea calmes down a bit,
you can come back. We can't depart
right now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
等海况稍微平静一点，你再回来吧。我们现在无法出发。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What a time for sailing!
The wind of the sea is so cool.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
真是扬帆的好时候！
海风凉爽宜人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You didn't have to accompany me
through this dangerous sailing...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不必陪我经历这次危险的航行...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Such as I am, I know the
sea a lot better than you!
And this ship has been my
friend through all my life!
I wouldn't abandon a friend.
Would you? ~
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
像我这样的人，比你知道的海况多多了！
而且这艘船是我一生的挚友！
我不会抛弃朋友的。
你会吗？~

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I will order you where to go, by
watching the seas.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我会通过观察海况，指挥你该往哪里走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You just adjust the direction of
the rudder by following my orders.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你只需要听从我的指令，调整舵的方向。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
At first, hold the rudder to go
forward, to the east.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
首先，把舵打向正前方，朝东航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Keep the direction by holding the
rudder to move forward to the
East.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
保持方向，把舵打向正前方，继续向东航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hm. The sea currents have changed.
Adjust the rudder forward to the
North, to follow the currents.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嗯。洋流变了。
把舵打向正前方，朝北航行，顺着洋流走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Nothing yet... Nothing has changed
in the flow of water. There is
nothing to note...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
还没有... 水流没有变化。
没有什么值得注意的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
We had better keep sailing on this
heading for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我们最好暂时保持这个航向继续航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
We must first repulse the
monsters!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我们必须先击退魔物！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey!
Did you not hear me?
Change the rudder forward to the
North, and follow the currents!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嘿！
你没听到吗？
把舵打向正前方，朝北航行，顺着洋流走！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Look... Beyond the sea!
Do you see something moving
mysteriously?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
看... 海的那一边！
你看到有什么东西在神秘地移动吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Heheh... What is...
that... Hey! You...
Go around the deck to look more
carefully! Go!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嘿嘿... 那是...
什么... 嘿！你...
去甲板周围仔细看看！快！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What are you doing...? Go around
the deck to look more carefully!
Go!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你在干什么...？去甲板周围仔细看看！
快！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
This time, I hope to find that
whale island again without any
incidents...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
这次，希望能再次找到那个鲸鱼岛，而且不出任何意外...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
The method is the same as before.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
方法和之前一样。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I will order you where to go, by
watching the seas.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我会通过观察海况，指挥你该往哪里走。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You just adjust the direction of
the rudder by following my orders.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你只需要听从我的指令，调整舵的方向。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
At first, hold the rudder to go
forward, to the east.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
首先，把舵打向正前方，朝东航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Keep the direction by holding the
rudder to move forward to the
East.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
保持方向，把舵打向正前方，继续向东航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Look there!
There is a moving island!
We have done well!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
看那里！
有一座移动的岛屿！
我们成功了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh...my...
It really is there...
A whale! It's unbelievable!
It is as true as that...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哦...我的...
它真的在那里...
是鲸鱼！难以置信！
就像... 那是真的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I feel I can go anywhere with you!
Even through impossible things!
Haha! You are a friend who brings
good luck.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我觉得只要有你在，我就能去任何地方！
即使是不可思议的事情！
哈哈！你是带来好运的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Okay, now that you have landed on
the island, I have to go back...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
好了，既然你已经登上了岛屿，我就得回去了...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
If another wave crashes against
this boat, I feel she might break
into pieces!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
如果再有海浪拍打这艘船，我觉得它可能会散架！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Good luck. I hope you
can return without problems.
I will pray for you.
See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
祝你好运。希望你能平安归来。
我会为你祈祷的。
下次见。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What? How did you get on
this ship?? You... No.
I'll forgive you this once, but go
back now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
什么？你是怎么上这艘船的？
你...不。
这次就原谅你了，但现在立刻回去。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hm. The sea currents have changed.
Adjust the rudder forward to the
{0}, to follow the currents.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嗯。海流改变了。
请将船头转向{0}，顺着海流前进。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Nothing yet... Nothing has changed
in the flow of water. There is
nothing to note...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
还没有... 水流没有变化。
没有什么值得注意的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
We had better keep sailing on this heading for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我们最好暂时保持这个航向继续航行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey!
Did you not hear me?
Change the rudder forward to the
{0}, and follow the currents!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嘿！
你没听到吗？
将船头转向{0}，顺着海流前进！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You don't have to adjust the rudder for now.
Wait for my direction.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
现在不需要调整船舵。
等待我的指令。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Do not yet adjust the rudder.
Only when I order you to,
you adjust the rudder.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
现在不要调整船舵。
只有在我下令时，你才调整船舵。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
We should make sure to kill any
monsters onboard.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我们必须确保消灭船上所有的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Do not yet adjust the rudder.
Only when I order you to,
you adjust the rudder.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
现在不要调整船舵。
只有在我下令时，你才调整船舵。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Look... Beyond the sea!
Do you see something moving
mysteriously?
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
看... 海的那一边！
你看到有什么东西在神秘地移动吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Heheh... What is...
that... Hey! You...
Go around the deck to look more
carefully! Go!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嘿嘿... 那是...
什么... 嘿！你...
去甲板周围仔细看看！快！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
You can adjust the rudder,
under my direction.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
你可以调整船舵了，
按照我的指令。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey! Listen to what I am saying.
How come you go there without my
permission...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嘿！听我说。
为什么没有经过我的允许就那样做...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
What? How did you get on
this ship?? You... No.
I'll forgive you this once, but go
back now.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
什么？你是怎么上这艘船的？
你...不。
这次就原谅你了，但现在立刻回去。

scripts.text: Which way?
scripts.translation: 哪个方向？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Good. Firstly, we should
keep heading {0} this way.
When I give the order,
please adjust the rudder again.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
很好。首先，
我们要保持向{0}的方向前进。
当我下达指令时，
请再次调整船舵。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Wait! Something has appeared in front of us...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
等等！前方出现了什么东西...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Monsters!!!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
魔物！！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
These monsters are like none I have
ever encountered! Be careful! We
must repulse these monsters!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
这些魔物是我从未见过的！小心！
我们必须击退这些魔物！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
I said that we should go {0}!
You should sail in the right
direction! To the {1}!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
我说过我们要向{0}前进！
你应该朝正确的方向航行！向{1}！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Oh no! Monsters have appeared!
Let's get ready to fight! Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
糟糕！魔物出现了！
准备战斗！快！

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You're carrying too many items.
Please come after using kafra service.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你携带的物品太多了。
请使用卡普拉服务后再来。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh, your awake.
How do you feel? Are you ok??
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
哦，你醒了。
感觉怎么样？没事吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hm... where..is...
Eck! What happened...?

[Aged Stranger]
Well... You were a bit
of a surprise! I haven't
talked for a long time...
with a person who lives on dry
land.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
嗯...你让我有点惊讶！
我已经很久没有和生活在陆地上的
人交谈了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I?
Who are you old man?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪里？
你是谁，老人家？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
This is... well...
What can I say...
This is called a moving island, by
most people.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
这里是...嗯...
该怎么说呢...
大多数人称之为“移动岛屿”。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
This is a small island that only I inhabit.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
这是一座只有我居住的小岛。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I call it...
Whale Island.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
我称它为...
鲸鱼岛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This place is very famously known
as The Moving Island! But... This
island is... Maybe...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这个地方非常有名，被称为“移动岛屿”！但是...这座岛...也许...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Now do you get it? Hahaha!
Right. We are standing on
the back of a gigantic whale!
That's why I call it Whale Island!
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
现在你明白了吗？哈哈！
没错。我们正站在一只巨大鲸鱼的背上！
所以我才叫它鲸鱼岛！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How...? How is it possible
that the water flows in streams
here? And trees grow! On the
whale's back!?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
怎么...？怎么可能
水在这里像溪流一样流动？
还有树木生长！在鲸鱼的背上！？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Heheheh. This is an island
of legend. Right now you are
experiencing greatness! Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
呵呵呵。这是一座传说中的岛屿。
你现在正体验着伟大！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you a real person?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是真人吗？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Heheh, as you can see,
I am just an aged man.
I've simply spent my lifetime here
leisurely, by breaking off
relations with any unworldly life.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
呵呵，正如你所见，
我只是一个年迈的男子。
我只是在这里悠闲地度过一生，
断绝了与世俗生活的一切联系。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Okay, now you get yourself
together. I will send you back to
dry land. If you don't go back
soon, some people may worry.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
好了，现在你整理一下自己。
我会把你送回陆地。如果你不快点回去，
有些人可能会担心的。

scripts.text:
-The island starts to move slowly
when the old man plays an
unfamiliar instrument...-
scripts.translation:
-当老人弹奏起一种陌生的乐器时，
岛屿开始缓慢移动...-

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
In a few minutes, you will go back
to the land from whence you came.
You can relax.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
再过几分钟，你就会回到你来的地方。
你可以放松一下。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hm... Almost there...
Young man, you will arrive back on
the mainland in a few minutes. Go carefully.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
嗯...快到了...
年轻男子，再过几分钟你就会回到大陆了。小心点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Old man, if I want to come back
here again, how can I do it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
老人家，如果我想再来这里，
该怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hehe... Do you want to come here
again? Here? Where I live alone? In
this small island? You are
funny...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
呵呵...你想再来这里吗？
这里？我独自居住的地方？
这座小岛上？你真有趣...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If we are preordained to meet,
we will meet here again,
won't we? Heheheh...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
如果我们有缘相遇，
我们就会在这里再次相见，
不是吗？呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
It's time to... well,
go back safely. Someday, if you
want to come again to meet me, you
can endure the same seas as last
time. I won't stop you. Hehehe.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
是时候...嗯，
安全回去了。如果有一天你想再来见我，
你可以像上次一样经历同样的风浪。
我不会阻止你。呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hahaha... I didn't know that I
would meet you again! How did you
return?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
哈哈哈...我不知道我会再次见到你！
你是怎么回来的？

scripts.text: Explain the whole story.
scripts.translation: 解释整个故事

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hm... just like that?
Whoever hasn't come here directly
would expect you to return like
that. Well.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
嗯...就这样？
没有直接来过这里的人
会以为你是这样回来的。好吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I just wanted to spend the rest of
my life here, leisurely... I'm
interested in the world... but I'm
no match for it...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
我只是想在这里安度余生，悠闲地生活...我对世界很好奇...但我无法与之抗衡...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Do not look sorry for me.
When you went back I didn't ask you
not to say anything about this
island to others.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
不要可怜我。
当你回去时，我并没有要求你
不要向其他人提起这座岛。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If I had decided to hide where
nobody can find... Well, you
needn't worry too much about that
now.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
如果我决定藏在一个没人找得到的地方...嗯，
你现在也不必太担心这个。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Anyway, are you troubled?
What are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
总之，你有心事吗？
你打算怎么做？

scripts.text: Think more.
scripts.translation: 再想想

scripts.text: Don't you have a way?
scripts.translation: 难道没有办法吗？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Do that. Think carefully, the
answer is to be found...
Hoohoohoo!
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
那就去做吧。仔细想想，
答案就在...那里。
呼呼呼呼！

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
To bring the Csar here and show him
everything?!? It's difficult...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
把皇帝带到这里，让他看到一切？！？这很难...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
An evidence of whale island...
That's all you need if only it
existed in this island...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
鲸鱼岛的证据...
只要它存在于这座岛上，
这就足够了...

scripts.text:
-The aged man closes his eyes and
starts to play his instrument, as
he falls in thought.-
scripts.translation:
-年迈的男子闭上眼睛，
开始演奏他的乐器，
陷入了沉思。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Old man, could you make one of
those instruments for me? That is a
marvelous thing that I've seen only
here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
老人，你能给我做一件那样的乐器吗？
那是我在别处从未见过的奇妙之物。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh... That's a good idea.
There isn't an instrument like this
in all Moscovia! Absolutely...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
哦...这是个好主意。
整个莫斯科比亚都没有这样的乐器！绝对...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hm... If you grant my request, I
will make this instrument for you.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
嗯...如果你答应我的请求，
我就为你制作这件乐器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is your request?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的请求是什么？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Just in time. I have always used
this instrument which is already
over 50 years old. The body is so
worn. It's not surprising that it's
falling apart...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
正好。我一直使用这把已经50多年的乐器。
琴身磨损得很厉害。它快要散架了也不奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
It is made with strings that only
exist in this place, but you can
get the other materials for it in
the mainland.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
它使用的是只有这里才有的琴弦，
但其他材料你可以在大陆上找到。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you bring the materials, I can
make a new one.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
如果你带来材料，
我就可以做一把新的。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
The materials are ^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
材料是 ^0000FF原木 30, 强韧木藤条 20, 魔羌之角 20, 海獭的皮革 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I won't move the island, so you can
find it when you come back with the
materials.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
我不会移动这座岛，所以当你带着材料回来时，
你能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Tell me whenever you're ready, and
I'll send you back to the
mainland.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
当你准备好了告诉我，
我会送你回大陆。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Okay, are you ready to go back to the mainland?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
好的，你准备好回大陆了吗？

scripts.text: What are the materials?
scripts.translation: 需要什么材料？

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You should bring these materials:
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你应该带上这些材料：

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You should bring these materials:
^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你应该带上这些材料：
^0000FF原木 30, 强韧木藤条 20, 魔羌之角 20, 海獭的皮革 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I see. If so, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
明白了。如果是这样，我们出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh... Did you get all the
materials?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
哦... 你集齐所有材料了吗？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You found the right materials.
Okay, I will start to make the
instrument.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你找到了正确的材料。
好的，我开始制作乐器了。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Wait for a moment until I make the
instrument successfully.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
请等一下，直到我成功制作出乐器。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Ugh... We need more materials...
We need ^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
唉... 我们需要更多材料...
我们需要 ^0000FF原木 30, 强韧木藤条 20, 魔羌之角 20, 海獭的皮革 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
What will you do? Will you go back
to the mainland to find the
materials?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你打算怎么做？要回大陆寻找材料吗？

scripts.text: What are the materials?
scripts.translation: 需要什么材料？

scripts.text: I am ready.
scripts.translation: 我准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You should bring these materials:
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你应该带上这些材料：

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You should bring these materials:
^0000FFLog 30, Tough Vines 20, Antelope Horn 20, Sea-otter Fur 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你应该带上这些材料：
^0000FF原木 30, 强韧木藤条 20, 魔羌之角 20, 海獭的皮革 10^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I see. If so, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
明白了。如果是这样，我们出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
It's not completed yet. Please wait a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
还没有完成。请再稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I have succeeded in making the
instrument! Here you are. It's yours.
This instrument is called a Gusli.
This is a traditional instrument
which comes from a faraway land of
the ancestors of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
我成功制作出乐器了！给你，这是你的。
这件乐器叫做古斯里琴。
这是一种来自莫斯科比亚祖先遥远故土的传统乐器。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I am the last person who has
learned it in this land.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
我是这片土地上最后一个学会它的人。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
So, indeed... This is a very
special item here, that only we
have.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
所以，确实... 这是一件非常特别的物品，只有我们拥有。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you show this to the good Csar,
he can believe your story about the
island. Everything is going to be
well.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
如果你把它展示给善良的沙皇看，
他就会相信关于这座岛的故事。一切都会好起来的。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Are you ready to learn the Gusli?
Please equip the Gusli.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你准备好学习古斯里琴了吗？
请装备古斯里琴。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Hm... Very well.
At first, look at me how I play,
then you play it slowly.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
嗯... 很好。
首先，看我怎么弹奏，
然后你慢慢弹奏。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Do not hurry,
keep your composure,
just look carefully,
and follow me slowly.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
不要着急，
保持镇定，
仔细观看，
跟着我慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh! Ooh... Your hands are really good. You are surely talented with a music instrument.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
哦！噢... 你的手真灵巧。你肯定很有音乐天赋。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I heard that there are some adventurers in the mainland... that like playing instruments and singing songs! You must be one of them...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
我听说大陆上有一些冒险者... 喜欢演奏乐器和唱歌！你一定是其中之一...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
This may go faster than I expected.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
这可能比我预期的要快。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Okay, it's time for your turn. Play it. Play the song that I played.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
好了，轮到你了。弹吧，弹我刚才弹的那首曲子。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Okay, it's time for your turn. Play it. Play the song that I played.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
好了，轮到你了。弹吧，弹我刚才弹的那首曲子。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Um... Your preparations are not

properly, and then you can learn.

scripts.text:

Tell me again when you are prepared
to play the Gusli correctly.
scripts.translation:

当你准备好正确弹奏古斯里琴时，再告诉我。

scripts.text:

Are you ready to learn the Gusli?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你准备好学习古斯里琴了吗？

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Um... You did well.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
嗯... 你做得不错。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
with your ability, you can
absolutely play it wonderfully.
Cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
以你的能力，绝对能演奏得非常精彩。加油。

scripts.text:

Good. Let's play again. Play the
song that I played.
scripts.translation:

很好。我们再弹一次。弹我刚才弹的那首曲子。

scripts.text:

song that I played.
scripts.translation:

properly, and then you can learn.

嗯... 你的准备还不够充分。你拿乐器的姿势不对。请正确装备它，然后才能学习。

scripts.text:

Tell me again when you are prepared
to play the Gusli correctly.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
当你准备好正确弹奏古斯里琴时，再告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
This is the Whale Island.
I don't know how you came here.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
这里是鲸鱼岛。
我不知道你是怎么来到这里的。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you want, I can send you back
to the mainland. What'll it be?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
如果你愿意，我可以送你回大陆。你想怎么做？

scripts.text: Look around.
scripts.translation: 四处看看

scripts.text: Go back to the mainland.
scripts.translation: 回到大陆

scripts.text: Venture into the unknown.
scripts.translation: 探索未知之地

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Well, well... Do as you please.
If so, I will take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
好吧，好吧... 随你便。
既然这样，我就休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I see. If so, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
明白了。如果是这样，我们出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh, if you want, I can
guide you to a good place for you.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
哦，如果你愿意，我可以指引你去一个适合你的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
There are some lands...
untouched and mysterious...
around Moscovia...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
在莫斯科比亚周围，
有一些土地...
未被触碰且充满神秘...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you want, I'll send you there. What do you think of that?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
如果你愿意，我就送你过去。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Consider it.
scripts.translation: 考虑一下

scripts.text: Ok, please send me there.
scripts.translation: 好的，请送我过去

scripts.text:

I see. If so, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
明白了。如果是这样，我们出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Long time, no see!
You probably like the island, don't you?
Please stay and take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
好久不见！
你大概很喜欢这座岛吧？
请留下来休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]

to the mainland. What'll it be?
scripts.translation:

或者如果你愿意，我可以送你回大陆。你想怎么做？

scripts.text: Look around.

scripts.text: Go back to the mainland.

scripts.text:

Good. I will go to the place
right way.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
很好。我这就去那个地方。

scripts.text:
A old man started to play a instrument
closing his eyes.
And then he didn't any answer so, looks like
falling down to only his world.
scripts.translation:
一位老人闭着眼睛开始弹奏乐器。
随后他不再回应，仿佛沉入了自己的世界。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Oh! You are good at playing the
Gusli! In such a short time... you
are great!
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
哦！你弹古斯里琴弹得真好！
在这么短的时间内...你太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You've done well. I don't need to
teach you anymore. Your ability
will be improved with more practice.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你做得很好。我不需要再教你了。
多加练习，你的技艺会越来越好。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Now go back to the mainland and
play the Gusli for our dear Csar.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
现在回到大陆，为我们敬爱的沙皇弹奏古斯里琴吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
With your ability to play, surely
you can win the admiration of all.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
以你的演奏水平，一定能赢得所有人的赞赏。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Um, a little bit greenhorn...
Do not play that way.
Take more time to concentrate while
you play.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
嗯，还有点生疏...
不要那样弹。
弹奏时要更专心，多花点时间集中精神。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Practice more on your own.
I will check on you again.
If you practice, you will be good
at it in no time.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
自己多练习吧。
我会再检查你的。
只要勤加练习，你很快就会弹好的。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
So, what will you do now?
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
那么，你现在打算做什么？

scripts.text: How would I get back here?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么回到这里？

scripts.text: Go back to the mainland.
scripts.translation: 回到大陆

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You are my friend now,
and you have this instrument.
Whenever you want to come back
here again, just play the Gusli
at the docks of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你现在是我的朋友，
而且你拥有这把乐器。
无论何时你想再回来，
只要在莫斯科比亚的码头弹奏古斯里琴即可。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Even if it's difficult to play it
well, because you may not yet know
how to play it, it's not a problem.
Just make a sound.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
即使很难弹好，因为你可能还不会弹，也没关系。
只要能发出声音就行。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
This island... this whale... can
perceive the sound of a Gusli from
an endless distance away.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
这座岛...这头鲸鱼...
能感知到从极远处传来的古斯里琴声。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
If you play this instrument,
wherever you are, I'll go to you
with this island. Only if you are a
friend... heheh.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
只要你弹奏这把乐器，
无论你在哪里，我都会带着这座岛去找你。只有你是朋友的话...嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
You really want to...
learn this instrument...
don't you?
Well... it's hard to learn
in such a short time...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
你真的想...
学习这把乐器...
对吧？
嗯...在短时间内学会很难...

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
It's okay if you can't play this
instrument. I already made it for you.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
如果你弹不好这把乐器也没关系。我已经为你做好了。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
But I can teach you how
to play it anyway.
I can't be too sure, though
because I have never taught others.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
但我还是教你怎么弹吧。
不过我不太确定，因为我从未教过别人。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Okay. If you are ready to play the
Gusli, let me know.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
好的。当你准备好弹奏古斯里琴时，告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
I see. Okay, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
明白了。好的，我们开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Aged Stranger]
Whenever you want to come back here
again, play the Gusli at the docks
of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
无论何时你想再回来，
只要在莫斯科比亚的码头弹奏古斯里琴即可。

scripts.text:

well, because you may not yet know

Just make a sound.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
即使很难弹好，因为你可能还不会弹，也没关系。
只要能发出声音就行。

scripts.text:

an endless distance away.
scripts.translation:

能感知到从极远处传来的古斯里琴声。

scripts.text:
