friend... heheh.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的陌生人]
只要你弹奏这把乐器，
无论你在哪里，我都会带着这座岛去找你。只有你是朋友的话...嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
-The old man starts to play
his instrument, with eyes closed.
He is unresponsive...
like having fallen into a world
only his own.-
scripts.translation:
-老人闭上眼睛，开始弹奏他的乐器。
他毫无反应...
仿佛陷入了一个只属于他自己的世界。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You're carrying too many items.
Please come after using kafra service.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你携带的物品太多了。
请先使用卡普拉服务后再来。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You!!!
So many people saw you
meet with Baba Yaga!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你！！！
有那么多人都看到你
和芭芭雅嘎见面了！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
The guilt which must be felt, when
meeting secretly with a witch...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
秘密会见女巫...
这种罪行所应感受到的愧疚...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
For that, we indict capital
punishment without any just trial!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
为此，我们将不经公正审判
直接判处死刑！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But you are a stranger to these
lands... So I will hold you in special trial.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
但你是这些土地上的陌生人...
所以我会为你举行特别审判。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If you have anything to say...
spare me no detail.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
如果你有什么要说的...
请不要隐瞒任何细节。

scripts.text: Explain the circumstances.
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
-Talk about what happened with Baba
Yaga, and move forward with the plan.-
scripts.translation: -讲述与芭芭雅嘎发生的事，并继续推进计划。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm-hm, that's an embarrassing story...
But if you are telling the
truth, my people will be pleased.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯嗯，这是个令人尴尬的故事...
但如果你说的是真话，
我的子民会感到欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Okay, Bring to me
any evidence, to believe
what you are saying.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
好的，给我带来任何证据，
以证明你所说的是真的。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You killed the Baba Yaga!!
If this is true, bring
me Yaga's Pestles.
If you do, I will make
sure no one ever doubts you.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你杀了芭芭雅嘎！！
如果这是真的，
就给我带来亚卡祖母的杵棒。
如果你做到了，我会确保
没有人再怀疑你。

scripts.text: Show the Yaga's Pestles.
scripts.translation: 出示亚卡祖母的杵棒

scripts.text: Do nothing.
scripts.translation: 什么都不做

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, Here you are.
-Offered the Yaga's Pestles.-
scripts.translation: -献上了亚卡祖母的杵棒。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm.. You do have them.
For the time being, I will admit
that you are coming and going to
hunt Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯.. 你确实有它们。
暂时，我承认你
是在往返猎杀芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But do not engage in doubtable
behavior that would instigate my
people to act in a strange way!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
但不要做出可疑的行为，
以免引起我的子民
采取奇怪的行动！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If you do that, I will arrest you immediately!
So take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
如果你那样做，我会立即逮捕你！
所以请小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
And, when you succeed in
banishing winter with magic,
announce that to me immediately.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
还有，当你成功
用魔法驱散冬天时，
立即向我报告。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I said to bring me
40 Yaga's Pestles
from the Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
我说过要你给我带来
40根芭芭雅嘎的亚卡祖母的杵棒。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Did you bring some evidence to
resolve your issue of doubt, traveler?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
旅行者，你带来了什么证据，
以消除你的疑虑吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I did.
scripts.translation: 是的，有。

scripts.text: I am confused.
scripts.translation: 我很困惑

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Good,
I won't doubt you anymore.
Because you've proven yourself,
you can remain a free traveler.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
很好，
我不再怀疑你了。
既然你证明了自己，
你可以继续作为自由的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Surely, I hate cooperating with Baba Yaga.
But if my people are happy
after the work you do,
I am also pleased.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
当然，我讨厌与芭芭雅嘎合作。
但如果我的工作完成后，
我的子民感到幸福，
我也很高兴。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
For the time being, I will admit
that you are coming and going to
hunt Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
暂时，我承认你
是在往返猎杀芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But do not engage in doubtable
behavior that would instigate my
people to act in a strange way!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
但不要做出可疑的行为，
以免引起我的子民
采取奇怪的行动！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If you do that, I will arrest you immediately!
So take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
如果你那样做，我会立即逮捕你！
所以请小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Your items do not match the
count of 40 Yaga's Pestles.
Did you forget the amount,
or did you wish to lie to me...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你的物品数量
与40根亚卡祖母的杵棒不符。
你是忘记了数量，
还是想对我撒谎...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I will treat that as a joke!
A kind of sarcasm!
You go away now and bring some
evidence to certify your innocence.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
我会把这当作一个玩笑！
一种讽刺！
现在离开，
带来一些证据来证明你的清白。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I said to bring me
40 Yaga's Pestles
from the Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
我说过要你给我带来
40根芭芭雅嘎的亚卡祖母的杵棒。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Are you here to tease me?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你是来这里取笑我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
It'd be great if I stayed put, for
the good of both me and my people.
I don't want to see the Baba Yaga
personally.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
如果我能保持不动，
对我自己和我的子民都有好处。
我不想亲自见到芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
So, I want you to 
take my place for that.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
所以，我希望你
代替我去做这件事。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Please help Baba Yaga
to seize the summer.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
请帮助芭芭雅嘎
夺取夏天。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Are you here for...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你是为了...而来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I already heard about the
weather from the minister.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
我已经从大臣那里
听说了天气的情况。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Actually, I was a little
dissatisfied with the doing
of witchcraft at the center
of the square...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
实际上，我对在广场中心
进行巫术的行为
有点不满意...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But... I can admit it was good work.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
但是...我可以承认
这是一项好的工作。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Everyone hates the cold winter.
Now, the winter will not
come anymore! So, I'm very pleased.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
每个人都讨厌寒冷的冬天。
现在，冬天不会再来了！
所以，我非常高兴。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Right.
I want to give you something
in the name of the people.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
是的。
我想以人民的名义
给你一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Here, take it.
I give it as an atonement
to make my people happy.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
拿着吧。
我把它作为赎罪，
让我的子民感到幸福。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Stay here as long as you want, and
enjoy yourself to the fullest this summer.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
想待多久就待多久，
在这个夏天尽情尽兴吧。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Welcome to Moscovia!
I am the ruler, Csar Aleksay III, of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
欢迎来到莫斯科比亚！
我是莫斯科比亚的统治者，沙皇 亚历克赛三世。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Go back to your hometown and talk about the beauty of Moscovia! Talk about my great government to all the people of the lands!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
回到你的家乡，向人们讲述莫斯科比亚的美丽吧！
向所有土地上的人民宣扬我伟大的统治！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
A foreign traveler...?
Do you have something to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
外来的旅行者...？
你有什么事要告诉我吗？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If it is not important,
have an audience with the Prime Minister first.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
如果不重要，
请先去见首相。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh, are you the traveler who told me about an interesting adventure story...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦，你是那位给我讲过有趣冒险故事的旅行者...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Not only are you not from Moscovia, but also... you have found the moving island, which only existed in legends! I want to hear details...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你不仅不是莫斯科比亚人，而且...你竟然找到了只存在于传说中的移动岛屿！我想听听详细的情况...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Let's hear it...
Tell me quickly.
I'm anxious to know the truth about the island...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
让我听听...
快说吧。
我迫切想知道关于那座岛屿的真相...

scripts.text: Tell the story all the while.
scripts.translation: 讲述整个故事

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Surely, an interesting story... But it sounds so unbelievable! What do you think, Prime Minister?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
确实是个有趣的故事...但这听起来太不可思议了！首相，你怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
It doesn't sound like a lie,
but it's difficult to believe
completely. I mean, I've known
a whale to be huge, but...
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
这听起来不像是在撒谎，
但也很难完全相信。我是说，我知道鲸鱼很大，但是...

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
a person living there...
water streaming...
and a tree growing on it...!!!
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
有人住在那里...
水流潺潺...
还有树长在上面...！！！
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I agree. I have heard many kinds of mysterious adventure stories, but this sounds like an absurd story!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
我同意。我听过许多种神秘的冒险故事，但这个听起来像个荒谬的故事！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Not to mention that it's happened near my nation. Unbelievable!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
更别提它发生在我国家附近了。难以置信！

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
But Csar... In my memory,
I heard that exactly, the
last time a story was told
about the mysterious moving island. But there was a musical instrument...which an old man played.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
但是沙皇...在我的记忆中，
我记得上一次听到关于神秘移动岛屿的故事时，
有一位老人正在演奏乐器。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Really? Tell me the details.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
真的吗？告诉我详细情况。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Surely, I have heard the same
story, as told in the legends
of our ancestors; about an old man who lived there.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
确实，我听过同样的故事，
就像祖先传说中那样；
关于一位住在那里的老人。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm. There are many doubtful points. Ordinarily, I would give you a big prize, but in this case, it is difficult to believe.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯。有很多疑点。通常我会给你丰厚的奖赏，但在这种情况下，很难相信。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Bring me something to prove
the existence of the whale.
If you do, I will give you a big prize.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
带些东西来证明鲸鱼的存在。
如果你做到了，我会给你丰厚的奖赏。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But if you don't,
I will punish you for your lies! Bring this instrument that supposedly an old man has.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
但如果你做不到，
我会惩罚你的谎言！把那位老人据称拥有的乐器带过来。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Csar... This is a foreigner...
No disrespect was meant to you.
Perhaps a little more generosity is in order?.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
沙皇...这位是外国人...
他并没有对您不敬。
或许可以稍微宽容一些？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
No way! If the story is not true, many other foreign travelers who pass by this land will disrespect me like this... What would you have me do?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
绝对不行！如果故事不是真的，那么许多经过这片土地的外国旅行者都会像这样对我无礼...你想让我怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
......
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
......

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You got it, traveler?
You have a heavy responsibility.
Bring evidence of this whale island to me, to provide me with some relief. Now go.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你明白了吗，旅行者？
你肩负着沉重的责任。
带些鲸鱼岛的证据来给我，让我安心。现在去吧。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I'm tired... I want to take a rest, so... leave.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
我累了...我想休息一下，所以...退下吧。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Just think about finding the whale island...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
好好想想怎么找到鲸鱼岛吧...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh. You've come back...
Hm. Did you find something to bring
to me from the whale island?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦。你回来了...
嗯。你找到什么可以带给我
来自鲸鱼岛的东西了吗？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Did you bring the instrument?
A Gooselri? Which only exists
in the whale island? Let's see.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你带了乐器来吗？
古斯里琴？那种只存在于
鲸鱼岛的乐器？让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh... Is this instrument... a Gooselri?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦...这件乐器...是古斯里琴吗？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Actually, Csar, I believe it is
called a Gusli.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
其实，沙皇，我认为它
应该叫古斯里琴。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh. Prime Minister, is this the
correct instrument from the
legends, then?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦。首相，这是传说中
正确的那件乐器吗？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I can't be sure, but this is
definitely an instrument never seen
in our lands before.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我不能确定，但这绝对是
我们这片土地上从未见过的乐器。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm. This is also my first time
seeing this kind of musical
instrument. So mysterious... Hey!
Can you play it?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯。这也是我第一次
见到这种乐器。真神秘...嘿！
你会弹吗？

scripts.text: I can play.
scripts.translation: 我会弹。

scripts.text: I can't play it.
scripts.translation: 我不会弹。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You can play it!
Good, play it right away!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你会弹！
很好，马上弹给我听！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Um... What is this? Do you mock me?
You are so impudent... You...!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯...这是什么？你在嘲笑我吗？
你太放肆了...你...！

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Csar... Calm down, please.
If you are quick to anger by such a
lowly person, it will become a
problem of prestige for you.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
沙皇...请冷静。
如果您因为这种卑微的人
而轻易发怒，那将成为
您的威信问题。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Agh... I agree with you.
You. Give a proper prize to the
adventurer and send them on their way.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
啊...我同意你的看法。
你。给这位冒险者
合适的奖赏，然后送他们离开。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
How can I re...reward...?
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我该怎么...奖励...？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I ordered you instead Prime
Minister, to make this poor player
disappear from in front of my eyes,
right now.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
我命令你，首相，
让这个可怜的玩家
立刻从我眼前消失。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You should be grateful for the
Csar's mercy... impudent
traveler...
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
你应该感激沙皇的仁慈...
放肆的旅行者...

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Even though I regard as your effort for the time so, award you. Take it and go out.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
虽然我认为你这段时间的努力值得肯定，但还是奖励你一下吧。拿着，然后离开。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Um... That's too bad.
I see... Will I ever believe...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯...真是遗憾。
我明白了...我会永远相信...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Thanks for your efforts.
Hey, Prime Minister,
reward this traveler.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
谢谢你的努力。
嘿，首相，
奖励这位旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
How can I reward the traveler?
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我该怎么奖励这位旅行者？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I leave the matter in your hands;
it's up to you. I will take a
rest.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
这件事就交给你了；
由你决定。我要去休息了。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
The Csar didn't take pleasure in
your story, as I expected.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
正如我所料，沙皇并没有
对你的故事感到高兴。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Even though I regard as your effort for the time so, award you. Take it.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
虽然我认为你这段时间的努力值得肯定，但还是奖励你一下吧。拿着。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
What are you doing? Can you play it
without even holding the musical instrument???
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你在做什么？不拿着乐器
也能演奏吗？？？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Don't be impudent with me! Do it right!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
别对我这么放肆！给我好好弹！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh you come...hum did you find
something to satisfy me
at the whale island?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦，你来了...哼，你在
鲸鱼岛找到了什么能让我
满意的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh... Is this instrument... a Gooselri?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦...这件乐器...是古斯里琴吗？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Actually, Csar, I believe it is called a Gusli.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
其实，陛下，这东西叫古斯里琴。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh. Prime Minister, is this the
correct instrument from the
legends, then?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦。首相，这是传说中
正确的那件乐器吗？

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I can't be sure, but this is
definitely an instrument never seen
in our lands before.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我不能确定，但这绝对是
我们这片土地上从未见过的乐器。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm. This is also my first time
seeing this kind of musical
instrument. So mysterious... Hey!
Can you play it?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯。这也是我第一次
见到这种乐器。真神秘...嘿！
你会弹吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I learned how to play it at Whale Island.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我在鲸鱼岛学会了怎么弹它。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh! Oh!... You can play it!
Play it right away. I wonder about its sound.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦！哦！...你会弹！
马上弹给我听。我很好奇它的声音。

scripts.text:
-When the music of the Gusli is
played, all the people in the
Csar's Palace fall in with the tune.-
scripts.translation:
-当古斯里琴的音乐响起时，
沙皇宫里的所有人都
随着旋律摇摆起来。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh! I can't hear without tears.
That's a sad tune.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦！我听得都要哭了。
这是一首悲伤的曲子。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
That's right, Csar.
I have never heard a sad tune such as this.
Kh-huk. Sniff.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
是的，陛下。
我从未听过如此悲伤的曲子。
呼...吸。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Huk... You. Give a big prize to
this traveler!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
呼...你。给这位旅行者
一份丰厚的奖赏！

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Hukhuk... Sniff. How can I reward this?
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
呼...吸。我该怎么奖励他？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I leave this matter in your hands.
Give a proper prize to whom has
Shown me a great story and
beautiful music.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
这件事就交给你了。
给这位向我展示了精彩故事
和美妙音乐的旅行者
一份合适的奖赏。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I express thanks to you on behalf
of our dear Csar and all the people
in his palace. I will reward your
efforts, in the name of the Csar.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我谨代表我们敬爱的沙皇陛下
以及宫殿中的所有人
向您表示谢意。
我将以沙皇的名义
奖赏您的付出。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But you... Where do you keep the
instrument which you are to show me?
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
但是...你。
你要展示给我的乐器
放在哪里了？

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Don't you need to be holding the instrument, in order to play it???
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
难道你不该拿着乐器
才能演奏吗？？？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry. I will be ready now, and try again to play it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉。我现在准备好了，
请让我再试一次演奏。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
What happen... If you have special things go out.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
发生了什...如果你有什么
特别的东西要拿出来。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Um... You are a traveler as I saw.
If you have special things, don't interfere my rest.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯...我看你是个旅行者。
如果你有什么特别的东西，
请不要打扰我的休息。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Oh... You. ~
Nice to see you again.
I want for you to sometimes stop by here and play some music for me. ~
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
哦...你。
~
很高兴再次见到你。
我希望你偶尔能来这里
为我演奏一些音乐。~

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Welcome to Moscovia,
I am Csar Alexsay the Third.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
欢迎来到莫斯科比亚，
我是沙皇 亚历克赛三世。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Go back to your hometown and tell everyone about the beauty of Moscovia,
and my great government.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
回到你的家乡，
告诉所有人莫斯科比亚的美丽，
以及我伟大的统治。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You!!!
So many people saw you
meet with Baba Yaga!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你！！！
有那么多人都看到你
和芭芭雅嘎见面了！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
The guilt which must be felt, when
meeting secretly with a witch...
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
秘密会见女巫...
这种罪行所应感受到的愧疚...

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
For that, we indict capital
punishment without any just trial!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
为此，我们将不经公正审判
直接判处死刑！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But you are a stranger to these
lands... So I will hold you in special trial.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
但你是这些土地上的陌生人...
所以我会为你举行特别审判。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If you have anything to say...
spare me no detail.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
如果你有什么要说的...
请不要隐瞒任何细节。

scripts.text: Explain the circumstances.
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
-Talk about what happened with Baba
Yaga, and move forward with the plan.-
scripts.translation: -讲述与芭芭雅嘎发生的事，并继续推进计划。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm-hm, that's an embarrassing story...
But if you are telling the
truth, my people will be pleased.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯嗯，这是个令人尴尬的故事...
但如果你说的是真话，
我的子民会感到欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Okay, Bring to me
any evidence, to believe
what you are saying.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
好的，给我带来任何证据，
以证明你所说的是真的。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
You killed the Baba Yaga!!
If this is true, bring
me Yaga's Pestles.
If you do, I will make
sure no one ever doubts you.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
你杀了芭芭雅嘎！！
如果这是真的，
就给我带来亚卡祖母的杵棒。
如果你做到了，我会确保
没有人再怀疑你。

scripts.text: Show the Yaga's Pestles.
scripts.translation: 出示亚卡祖母的杵棒

scripts.text: Do nothing.
scripts.translation: 什么都不做

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, Here you are.
-Offered the Yaga's Pestles.-
scripts.translation: -献上了亚卡祖母的杵棒。-

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
Hm.. You do have them.
For the time being, I will admit
that you are coming and going to
hunt Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
嗯.. 你确实有它们。
暂时，我承认你
是在往返猎杀芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
But do not engage in doubtable
behavior that would instigate my
people to act in a strange way!
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
但不要做出可疑的行为，
以免引起我的子民
采取奇怪的行动！

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
If you do that, I will arrest you immediately!
So take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
如果你那样做，我会立即逮捕你！
所以请小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
And, when you succeed in
banishing winter with magic,
announce that to me immediately.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
还有，当你成功
用魔法驱散冬天时，
立即向我报告。

scripts.text:
[Csar Alexsay III]
I said to bring me
40 Yaga's Pestles
from the Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[沙皇 亚历克赛三世]
我说过要你给我带来
40根芭芭雅嘎的亚卡祖母的杵棒。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You are in trouble if
you conspire against the Csar,
so, make your actions carefully,
and if you want to clean yourself
from suspicion... do everything you
can to prove your innocence.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
如果你密谋反对沙皇，
那就大祸临头了。
所以，请谨慎行事。
如果你想洗清嫌疑...
请尽你所能证明你的清白。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You have just cleared your name,
but... we don't trust you wholly yet.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
你刚刚洗清了名声，
但是...我们还没有完全信任你。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I can't trust you, but...
if you succeed in taking hold of
the summer... I might be able to.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我无法信任你，但是...
如果你能成功掌控夏季...
我或许可以。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
We know that you mean well.
But we can't fully trust you,
so we kept an eye on your movements.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我们知道你心存善意。
但我们无法完全信任你，
所以我们一直在监视你的动向。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I heard that you performed
witchcraft at the palace square...
so, I ordered scholars to
investigate the weather.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我听说你在宫殿广场
施展了巫术...
所以，我命令学者们
调查天气情况。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
The results from taking observation
of the weather, are the reducing
change of temperature, and that the
highest temperature is now stabilized.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
对天气进行观测的结果显示，
气温变化正在减少，
且最高温度现在已趋于稳定。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I don't know what this may mean, by
way of principle, but I've decided
to admit the facts.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我不知道这在原则上意味着什么，
但我决定承认这一事实。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Already, our dear Csar knows.
I finished the report.
Go and announce it to him.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我们敬爱的沙皇已经知道了。
报告已经写好。
去向他禀报吧。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You are a foreign traveler. This is the Moscovia Palace, home of Csar Aleksay the Third. Extending your every courtesy here... is not bad manners.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
你是一位外国旅行者。这里是莫斯科比亚宫殿，
沙皇 亚历克赛三世的居所。
在这里保持礼貌...
并不是什么坏事。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Traveler, why have you come to the Csar's Palace?
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
旅行者，你为何来到沙皇宫殿？

scripts.text: Just to look around.
scripts.translation: 只是四处看看

scripts.text: To see the dear Csar.
scripts.translation: 想见见敬爱的沙皇。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
If so... look around with caution. Do not bother the Csar.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
如果是这样...请小心四处看看。不要打扰沙皇。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Moscovia welcomes all travelers such as yourself!
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
莫斯科比亚欢迎所有像您这样的旅行者！

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Marvelously, our dear Csar likes it very much when interesting stories are often told to him.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
奇妙的是，我们敬爱的沙皇非常喜欢听有趣的故事。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Did you come to see our dear Csar? If so, tell me your business with him in advance.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
您是来见我们敬爱的沙皇的吗？如果是，请提前告诉我您的来意。

scripts.text: I'd like to say hello.
scripts.translation: 我想打个招呼。

scripts.text: I have an adventure story for him.
scripts.translation: 我有一个冒险故事要讲给他听。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I will tell him directly about your business. You don't need to worry yourself with the Csar.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我会直接向沙皇禀报您的来意。您不必担心与沙皇的对话。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I wonder what sort of things have happened to you... The Csar will be very pleased to hear your stories.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我很好奇您身上发生了什么...沙皇听到您的故事一定会很高兴的。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I will admit you. If our dear Csar is satisfied with your story, he will give you a big prize.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我会为您引荐。如果敬爱的沙皇对您的故事满意，他会给您丰厚的赏赐。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I already announced you,
so go see him and speak to him directly.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我已经为您通报过了，
快去见他，直接与他对话吧。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Now, our dear Csar needs a rest.
You should do your duty and go find the whale island.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
现在，我们敬爱的沙皇需要休息。
您应该履行您的职责，去寻找鲸鱼岛。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Ah! You've come back.
I will request for you to see him immediately.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
啊！您回来了。
我会立刻为您请求觐见。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
I don't want to hear your terrible 
performance anymore so, go out away.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
我不想再听您那糟糕的表演了，出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
What's up? Dear Chare is taking a rest.
If you have nothing special, go out.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
怎么了？敬爱的沙皇正在休息。
如果没有特别的事情，请出去吧。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
Your Gusli performance was so touching.
Unforgettable! Whenever you are here, please allow us to hear that tune again.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
您的古斯里琴演奏太动人了。
令人难忘！只要您在这里，请允许我们再听一次那首曲子。

scripts.text:
[Prime Minister Dmitree]
You are a foreign traveler. This is a palace
which lives Alexei the Third.
Extend you every courtesy don't not bad manner.
scripts.translation:
[首相 德米特里]
你是一位外国旅行者。这里是亚历克赛三世居住的宫殿。
请保持礼貌，不要失礼。

scripts.text:
-Watching the sea from the docks,
it suddenly dawns upon you that you
have memories from Whale Island.-
scripts.translation:
-望着码头上的大海，
你突然想起了鲸鱼岛的回忆。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Stop by the whale island?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
去鲸鱼岛看看？

scripts.text: Go to Whale Island.
scripts.translation: 前往鲸鱼岛

scripts.text: Stay put.
scripts.translation: 留在原地

scripts.text:
-Slowly, your hands are on the
Gusli, and the playing starts...
reminding you of the melody which
the aged stranger had played...-
scripts.translation:
-慢慢地，你的手放在了古斯里琴上，演奏开始了...
让你想起了那位年迈的陌生人曾弹奏过的旋律...-

scripts.text:
[Village resident]
So...something is rising from the sea!!!
scripts.translation:
[村中居民]
天哪...有什么东西从海里升起来了！！!

scripts.text:
[Village Youth]
What...What is that...??
scripts.translation:
[村里的年轻人]
那...那是什么...？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Ohohoh!... That's the whale
island...!!! Someday, I hope to go there! Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
哦哦哦！...那是鲸鱼岛...！！！总有一天，我要去那里看看！哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh my goodness... Slipped right out
of my mind... to forget equipping the Gusli.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...我竟然忘了...忘了装备古斯里琴。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The aged stranger said that when I
want to go to Whale Island again, I
should play the Gusli from this place...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那位年迈的陌生人说过，当我想再去鲸鱼岛时，
应该在这里弹奏古斯里琴...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can go some other time.
I will do other work now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以改天再去。
现在先做点别的事。

scripts.text: seeewaaaaaaaaaaa
scripts.translation: 呜哇啊啊啊啊啊

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Hey {0}! Look!
It's dangerous! Hide! Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
嘿 {0}！快看！
很危险！快躲起来！快！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That... that is...

[{0}]
Something... something is rising...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有什么东西...有什么东西正在升起...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Watch out! {0}!
Ah... That... That is... What...
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
小心！{0}！
啊...那...那是...什么...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Ibanoff]
Now that all the monsters are gone,
we can start sailing again
normally.
scripts.translation:
[伊巴诺夫先生]
既然所有的魔物都消失了，
我们可以正常出海了。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Oh, where the heck is he?
I'll teach him a lesson.
He's timid like Dad.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
哦，那个混蛋在哪里？
我要好好教训他。
他胆小得像爸爸一样。

scripts.text:
[Anna]
Mikhail, he's a coward, a crybaby.
Mikhail, he's a coward, a crybaby.
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
米哈伊尔，他是个胆小鬼，爱哭鬼。
米哈伊尔，他是个胆小鬼，爱哭鬼。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
It's because you didn't look after your brother. So you clean the house, Anna?
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
因为你没有照顾好你的弟弟。所以你要打扫房子，安娜？

scripts.text: Talk to her.
scripts.translation: 和她说话

scripts.text: Just pass by her
scripts.translation: 直接走过

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I'm worried that he's making trouble somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
我担心他在哪里惹麻烦了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, there?

[Gallina]
Oh, God!
I didn't see you there. Sorry!
You want to buy a hotcake, don't you?
I'm sorry but we're not ready to open the store..
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
天哪！
我没看到你在那儿。抱歉！
你是想买松饼吗？
抱歉，我们还没准备好开店...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that's ok.
Is there something that I can help with? What's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。
有什么我可以帮忙的吗？发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Oh, well...
My son, Mikhail broke our Matrushka while I was away from home.
He's afraid that I would punish him. So he ran away.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
哦，那个...
我儿子米哈伊尔趁我不在家的时候打坏了我们的套娃。
他怕我惩罚他，所以跑掉了。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
How timid the boy is!
I doubt that he'd be able to be a great general in the future
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
这孩子真胆小！
我怀疑他将来能当上大将军。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
He used to come home at this time.
I'm worried that something bad has happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
他以前这个时候都会回家的。
我担心他出了什么事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You look anxious. I'd like to help you to find your son.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起来很焦虑。我想帮你找到你的儿子。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Did you say I'm anxious?
I'm just anxious for him to get home.
...So I can punish him for what he did.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
你说我焦虑？
我只是担心他什么时候能回家。
...这样我就可以惩罚他做的事了。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
But it's not good that I refuse your kindness
Will you find Mikhail for me?
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
但我不能拒绝你的好意。
你愿意帮我找米哈伊尔吗？

scripts.text: I was not serious.
scripts.translation: 我不是认真的。

scripts.text: Yes, I will!
scripts.translation: 是的，我会的！

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
You meanie! I'm not in the mood for jokes.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
你这个坏蛋！我没心情开玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Oh, God, You're so kind
Mikhail is such a timid boy. I guess he didn't leave this village.
Please bring him to me, then~
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
天哪，你真好。
米哈伊尔是个胆小的男孩。我想他没有离开这个村庄。
请把他带给我，好吗~

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Mikhail, my timid son must still be in this village.
I'm sorry if he's shy and timid like his father.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
米哈伊尔，我胆小的儿子一定还在这个村庄里。
如果他和父亲一样害羞胆小，我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mikhail hasn't come yet?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
米哈伊尔还没回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
No, where on earth is he?
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
没有，他到底在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
He came back with my Matrushka roughly pasted together and just left...
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
他带着我的套娃回来了，虽然只是勉强粘在一起的，然后就走了...

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I'm sorry that I treated the little boy badly.
He did his best in his own way.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
抱歉我那样对待小男孩。
他尽力用自己的方式做了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's ok. You will be a sweet mom to your little boy. haha
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没关系。你会成为小男孩的好妈妈。哈哈

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Yes. I'm sure I will. hoho..
Anna, my daughter made a mistake. She laid the blame upon her brother alone. I'll punish her too.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
是的。我相信我会的。呵呵...
安娜，我的女儿犯了错。她把责任全推给了弟弟。我也会惩罚她的。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I appreciate your effort. You went to a dangerous place to find my son
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
我很感激你的付出。你去了危险的地方寻找我的儿子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It often happens to me, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这种事经常发生在我身上，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I can't afford to reward you with much but... I'll let you know how to make a delicious hotcake!
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
我没法给你太丰厚的奖励，但是...我会告诉你怎么做美味的松饼！

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I have to work now but Larissa will tell you about that. She's our maid..
She's really a nice cook.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
我现在得去工作了，拉丽莎会告诉你怎么做。她是我们的女仆...
她真的很擅长烹饪。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Hotcakes of Moscovia are so delicious!
Once you make it, I bet you that you'll love it.
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
莫斯科比亚的松饼非常美味！
一旦你学会了做，我敢打赌你会爱上它的。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
Well, now I have to get to work!
I'll make you my hotcakes someday. Please visit me later
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
好了，我现在得去工作了！
总有一天我会做松饼给你吃。请稍后再来拜访我。

scripts.text:
[Gallina]
I'm always trying to prepare a new dish.
What do you think of 'the most spicy chili hotcake in the world'?
I think that will be great!
scripts.translation:
[加利纳]
我一直在尝试准备新菜式。
你觉得“世界上最辣的辣椒松饼”怎么样？
我觉得那会很棒！

scripts.text:
[Anna]
Mikhail, he's a coward, a crybaby.
Mikhail, he's a coward, a crybaby.
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
米哈伊尔，他是个胆小鬼，爱哭鬼。
米哈伊尔，他是个胆小鬼，爱哭鬼。

scripts.text:
[Anna]
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: About where Mikhail might be hiding
scripts.translation: 关于米哈伊尔可能藏身的地方

scripts.text: About their relationship
scripts.translation: 关于他们的关系

scripts.text: About the situation
scripts.translation: 关于目前的情况

scripts.text: Ask her about other things
scripts.translation: 问她其他事情

scripts.text: End the conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where is Mikhail?
Do you know where he is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
米哈伊尔在哪里？
你知道他在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Anna]
If I had known that, I would have already found him, you fool.
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
如果我知道的话，我早就找到他了，你这个笨蛋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hahaha, you're right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈哈哈哈，你说得对。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How's your relationship with your brother?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你和弟弟的关系怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Anna]
Mikhail always stays behind me and asks me to read books!
And he cries too much.
It annoys me.
And he only wants to play with me. That's why he has no friends.
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
米哈伊尔总是跟在我身后，让我给他读书！
而且他哭得太多了。
这让我很烦。
他只愿意和我玩。这就是为什么他没有朋友。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You seem very courageous.
I can understand why your mother worries about him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起来很勇敢。
我能理解你妈妈为什么担心他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What were you doing when Mikhail broke your mother's Matrushka?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
米哈伊尔打碎你妈妈的套娃时，你在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Anna]
I was there.
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
我就在旁边。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh were you?

[Anna]
When my parents were out, they asked me to take care of Mikhail.
I didn't want to do that but I'm his sister so I was reading a book next to him.
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
爸妈不在家的时候，让我照顾米哈伊尔。
虽然我不太想，但我是他姐姐，所以我就坐在他旁边看书。

scripts.text:
[Anna]
He began to tease me to read a book for him and later, he annoyed me saying that he's hungry!
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
他开始缠着我给他读书，后来又说饿了，真是烦死了！

scripts.text:
[Anna]
I was so bothered with him and I pretended not to hear him and kept reading. I guess it made him mad and so he broke the Matrushka.
scripts.translation:
[安娜]
被他搞得头都大了，我就假装没听见，继续看书。我想他应该是生气了，所以才把套娃打碎的。

scripts.text:
[Anna]
He made trouble and began to cry!
He's such a timid boy...
(giggling)

scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
想吃松饼的时候，随时欢迎过来。
我会为你烤出最美味的松饼。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Did the pancake taste good?
Would you like another pancake?
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
松饼好吃吗？
还要再来一块吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Let me check if you have all the ingredients.
A frying pan, milk... potion that softens the dough, cheese..honey..and firewood.
Perfect!
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
让我检查一下你是否备齐了材料。
平底锅、牛奶...软化面团的药水、奶酪...蜂蜜...还有柴火。
完美！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Let us begin by kneading the dough.
I'll add sugar and baking powder.
It can be mixed well with this sieve.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
我们先来揉面团。
我会加入糖和泡打粉。
用这个筛子可以混合得很均匀。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
What should I do with the wheat flour?
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
小麦粉应该怎么处理呢？

scripts.text: Turn it down.
scripts.translation: 调小火。

scripts.text: Pass it through a sieve.
scripts.translation: 用筛子过筛。

scripts.text: Press it with your fist.
scripts.translation: 用拳头按压。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Oh, my! What are you doing now?
I'm going to do that from the beginning.
Look, pass it through a sieve.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
哎呀！你现在在做什么？
我要从头开始做。
看，用筛子过筛。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
There you go. Just do it slowly while tapping the sides, sifting the sugar and baking powder through the sieve together.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
就是这样。慢慢来，一边轻敲筛子边缘，一边将糖和泡打粉一起过筛。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
If we don't have the sieve, we can use our fist but we've got one. So we might as well use it right?
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
如果没有筛子，可以用拳头，但我们现在有筛子。所以还是用它比较好，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
That way, it will mix well.
And then I'm adding an egg, some milk and a white potion.
What next?
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
这样混合得更均匀。
然后我加入一个鸡蛋、一些牛奶和一瓶白色药水。
接下来该做什么？

scripts.text: Stir it up with great speed.
scripts.translation: 快速搅拌。

scripts.text: Do the same as she said.
scripts.translation: 照她说的做。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
No, you don't have to do that way. It won't rise properly if you stir it too fast.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
不，不需要那样做。如果搅拌得太快，面团就不会发起来。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
You're very good at this!
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
你很擅长这个！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
It'll rise while baking if you stir it properly
Ok, let me bake now. Let's pour it on our pan and spread it around.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
只要搅拌得当，烤的时候就会膨胀。
好了，让我来烤。把它倒进平底锅里，摊开。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Cook in low temperature. It'll rise and have bubbles on it.
When you see the bubbles, you can turn it over.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
用低温烹饪。它会膨胀并冒出气泡。
看到气泡时，就可以翻面了。

scripts.text: Cook in high temperature.
scripts.translation: 用高温烹饪。

scripts.text: Can I turn it over now?
scripts.translation: 现在可以翻面了吗？

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
No, you don't do that.
You'll burn it up.
Wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
不，不要那样做。
你会把它烤焦的。
再等一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Hmm let's see. It's good.
You were good at it.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
嗯，让我看看。不错。
你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok, turn it over. Oh it looks delicious
What should I top it with? First I put some cheese but the rest is up to you...
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
好，翻面吧。看起来很好吃。
我该加什么配料呢？我先放了一些奶酪，剩下的由你决定...

scripts.text: Caviar
scripts.translation: 鱼子酱

scripts.text: Mushrooms
scripts.translation: 蘑菇

scripts.text: Honey
scripts.translation: 蜂蜜

scripts.text: Strawberry jam
scripts.translation: 草莓果酱

scripts.text: Sour cream
scripts.translation: 酸奶油

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok. you want caviar. Fortunately, I still have a little left.
Hoohoo, this'll be luxurious..
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
好，你要鱼子酱。幸好我还剩一点。
哇，这下会很奢华呢。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok. you want mushrooms.. It has an earthly flavor.
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
好，你要蘑菇。它有一种泥土的芬芳。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok, honey syrup goes perfectly with pancakes.
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
好，蜂蜜糖浆和煎饼是绝配。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Who could get sick of pancakes with strawberry jam?
Hoohoo it tastes sweet too.
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
谁能抗拒草莓果酱煎饼呢？
哇，味道也很甜美。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
You want sour cream.. you will feel as if you fly in the sky.
It can help reduce stress.
Here we go. It's all done!
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
你要酸奶油...你会感觉像在天空中飞翔。
它能帮助缓解压力。
好了，完成了！

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
That's good. I have ingredients and several toppings but...
It's still not enough. You need to get all of the things that we don't have now.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
很好。我有食材和几种配料，但是...
还是不够。你需要去弄齐我们现在缺少的东西。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
I need ^4d4dff1 old frying pan , 2 bottles of milk , 2 white potion, 1 cheese, 1 Trunk, 1 Honey ^000000.
We can bake our pancake when we get all of those.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
我需要^4d4dff1个破旧平底锅、2瓶牛奶、2瓶白色药水、1块奶酪、1个树干、1瓶蜂蜜^000000。
集齐这些后，我们就可以烤煎饼了。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Ok we can bake it next time.
I'm always available.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
好，下次我们可以烤。
我一直都在。

scripts.text:
[Larissa]
Young lady is a practical joker and her brother is tenderhearted.
By the way, I haven't seen him for quite some time.
scripts.translation:
[拉丽莎]
年轻女士是个爱开玩笑的人，她的哥哥则很温柔。
顺便说一下，我已经很久没见到他了。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
We have very fresh acorns. Everyone will like them!
You can buy one acorn for 100zeny!
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
我们有非常新鲜的橡子。大家都会喜欢的！
你可以用100 Zeny买一个橡子！

scripts.text: Buy one.
scripts.translation: 买一个

scripts.text: What can I use them for?
scripts.translation: 它们有什么用？

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Well uh...
You can grind them to make
something to eat and you can feed squirrels.
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
呃...
你可以把它们磨碎做成食物，
也可以喂松鼠。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Someone can decorate their house
with them but I don't know how...
they've got to be highly talented.
Haha.
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
有人会用它们来装饰房子，
但我不太懂...
那需要非常有天赋才行。
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
I'll bet you that they are very fresh!
How many acorns do you need?
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
我敢打赌它们非常新鲜！
你需要多少个橡子？

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Do you want to cancel this trade?
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
你要取消这笔交易吗？

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
You can't buy more than 500.
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
你一次不能买超过500个。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Hello, I think you can't get acorns
now. You're carrying too many
items!
Please use Kafra service. I'll be
right here.
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
你好，我想你现在拿不了橡子了。
你携带的物品太多了！
请使用卡普拉服务。我就在这里。

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Hello? You've turned pale! Are you ok??
Do you have enough money?
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
你好？你脸色好苍白！没事吧？
你的钱够吗？

scripts.text:
[Acorn Dealer]
Oh, thank you...
What do you think of them? They're fresh, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[橡子商人]
哦，谢谢...
你觉得它们怎么样？很新鲜，对吧？

scripts.text:
- Please stop here!! -
- You're carrying too many items -
- Please try again -
- after using the kafra service -
scripts.translation:
- 请在此停下！！ -
- 您携带的物品过多 -
- 请先使用卡普拉服务 -
- 然后再试一次 -

scripts.text: - It's an extraordinary big squirrel. -
scripts.translation: - 这是一只巨大的松鼠。 -

scripts.text: - When the animal comes across you, it starts to sniffle and purse up its lips. -
scripts.translation: - 当这只动物靠近你时，它开始嗅来嗅去，并撅起了嘴唇。 -

scripts.text: Give acorns to it.
scripts.translation: 给它橡子

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 无视它

scripts.text: Ask about the squirrel.
scripts.translation: 询问关于松鼠的事

scripts.text: - You take one of acorns out and hold it out to the squirrel. -
scripts.translation: - 你拿出一颗橡子，递给松鼠。 -

scripts.text: - It cocked it's ears up and begins to nibble the acorn quickly. -
scripts.translation: - 它竖起耳朵，开始快速地啃食橡子。 -

scripts.text:
- It makes a crunching sound -
- It makes a crunching sound -
- It makes a crunching sound -
scripts.translation:
- 发出咔嚓咔嚓的声音 -
- 发出咔嚓咔嚓的声音 -
- 发出咔嚓咔嚓的声音 -

scripts.text: - After eating the acorn up, the squirrel dances around wildly. Suddenly it curls its body and throws something up with a spit-spit sound -
scripts.translation: - 吃完橡子后，松鼠疯狂地跳起舞来。突然它蜷缩起身体，伴随着噗噗的声音吐出了什么东西 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's so cute.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它好可爱。

scripts.text:
[Aged Man]
Is it bigger than an ordinary one?
I found it one day and was barely able to save it...
scripts.translation:
[年迈的男子]
它比普通的大吗？
有一天我发现它时，差点没能救下它...

scripts.text:
[Aged Man]
I felt that heaven had sent me a friend so that my life wouldn't be so lonely.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的男子]
我觉得这是上天赐给我的朋友，让我的生活不再那么孤独。

scripts.text:
[Aged Man]
But I didn't know that it eats so much, it won't give me any attention if I give anything ^3131FFbelow 20 acorns^000000.
That's why it's bigger than ordinary ones hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[年迈的男子]
但我没想到它胃口这么大，如果给的橡子少于^3131FF20颗^000000，它根本不理我。
所以它才长得比普通松鼠大，哈哈。

scripts.text: - The squirrel looks at the acorn which you held for a while but it turned its head with indifference. -
scripts.translation: - 松鼠盯着你手中的橡子看了一会儿，然后冷漠地转过头去。 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Hohoho
I need to kick your ass more.
Come here,
to play a game.
Heeeeeeeee.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呼呼呼
我得好好揍你一顿。
过来，
陪我玩个游戏。
嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me live, leave me alone, and don't come near me.
Stop, I am hungry and scared.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
让我活命，别管我，离我远点。
住手，我又饿又怕。

scripts.text: -She is blabbing something weird.-
scripts.translation: - 她在胡言乱语。 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Yes, if you let me live, I will compensate you
with a present, how about that?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
是的，如果你让我活命，我会送你一份礼物作为补偿，怎么样？

scripts.text: A present?
scripts.translation: 礼物？

scripts.text: I don't need.
scripts.translation: 我不需要。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Yes, if you let me live
I will give you the Yaga Pestles
Aren't you gathering them?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
是的，如果你让我活命，
我会给你“雅嘎的研杵”。
你难道不是在收集它们吗？

scripts.text: I don't need them anymore.
scripts.translation: 我不再需要它们了。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Kaaaaaaaaaak!
Please, let me live,
I will do anything you want.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嘎啊啊啊啊啊！
求求你，让我活命，
你想让我做什么都行。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Don't you need any cream for wounds
or indigestion?
They are a bit dirty,
but very useful.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你不觉得需要治疗伤口
或消化不良的药膏吗？
虽然有点脏，
但非常有用。

scripts.text: Well...

[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
How about this?
I bewitch this country so that
the winter will never come here again.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
这样如何？
我施展魔法，让这里
永远不再迎来冬天。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I guess that people will like it and
I'm sure that the Csar
will award you for it.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我想人们会喜欢的，
而且我确信沙皇
会因此奖赏你。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah? You seem
interested... ya?
What do you think about that?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊？你似乎
很感兴趣... 是吗？
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Good, but I think you're lying.
scripts.translation: 不错，但我觉得你在撒谎。

scripts.text: I am not interested.
scripts.translation: 我不感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Sure, you can trust me.
It is so complicated that I cannot
perform it on my own
I am not a liar.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
当然，你可以相信我。
这件事太复杂了，我独自
无法完成。
我不是骗子。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
But, the problem is...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
但是，问题是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I am not able to get the materials necessary
because I don't feel good.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我身体不舒服，
无法获取所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
So,
if you give me a hand,
I can use the magic that
stops winter from returning. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
所以，
如果你能帮帮我，
我就能施展阻止冬天再次降临的魔法。
你愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会的。

scripts.text: No. I don't like it.
scripts.translation: 不，我不喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Heeeek,
Just, just I need a little help.. It is really little.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嘿...嘿...
我只是需要一点点帮助...真的只是一点点。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Please, don't kill me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
求求你，别杀我...

scripts.text: 'Hmmm, what should I do...'
scripts.translation: '嗯...我该怎么办呢...'

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Akkk... What on earth did you do to me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊...你到底对我做了什么...

scripts.text: Hmm... What do you want...
scripts.translation: 嗯...你想要什么...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Akkkk!
You came back..
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊！
你回来了...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
If you tell the Csar that
winter won't come back again
he will reward you.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
如果你告诉凯撒，
冬天不会再回来了，
他会奖励你的。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Isn't that better for you
than hurting me?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
这难道不是比伤害我更好吗？

scripts.text: Ok, tell me the story.
scripts.translation: 好，告诉我故事。

scripts.text: Let me think...
scripts.translation: 让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Certainly, trust me.
It is so complicated that I cannot
perform it on my own
I am not a liar.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
当然，你可以相信我。
这件事太复杂了，我独自
无法完成。
我不是骗子。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
The problem is...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
问题是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I am not able to get the materials necessary
because I don't feel good.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我身体不舒服，
无法获取所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
So,
if you give me a hand.
I can use the magic that
stops winter from returning. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
所以，
如果你能帮帮我，
我就能施展阻止冬天再次降临的魔法。
你愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会的。

scripts.text: No. I don't like it.
scripts.translation: 不，我不喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Heeeeek,
Just, just I need a little help.. It is really little.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嘿...嘿...
我只是需要一点点帮助...真的只是一点点。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Please, don't kill me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
求求你，别杀我...

scripts.text: 'Hmm... what should I do...'
scripts.translation: '嗯...我该怎么办呢...'

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You think more...
What do you want from me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你再想想...
你想要我做什么...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You just need to help little,
really little...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你只需要帮一点点忙，
真的只是一点点...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Well, did you change your mind?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嗯，你改变主意了吗？

scripts.text: Ok, let's try.
scripts.translation: 好，试试看。

scripts.text: Let me think more...
scripts.translation: 让我再想想...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You think more...
What do you want from me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你再想想...
你想要我做什么...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see...where the season spell...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
让我看看...那个季节咒语...

scripts.text: rummaging...
scripts.translation: 翻找中...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah, here it is... I found it!
Hoook~ Hoook~
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊，在这里...我找到了！
呼~呼~

scripts.text: -What a dusty old book!-

5 Spawn...
scripts.translation:

5个Spawn...

scripts.text:

eh... and...
20 Wings Of Red Bat...
scripts.translation:

20个红蝙蝠翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see...
a glue, no, to cast a spell

scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]

胶水，不对，施法需要
10个粘稠液体...

scripts.text: ...Are you sure?
scripts.translation: ...你确定吗？

scripts.text: A glue? You want me to kill you?!
scripts.translation: 胶水？你想害死我？！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Yes, yes, I am certain. Why don't you trust me...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
是的，是的，我很确定。你为什么不相信我...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Cough, cough,
I am coughing now, so do not disturb me,
you write them down.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
咳咳，
我现在正在咳嗽，别打扰我，
你把这些记下来。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
No, It just...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
不，只是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ehhh, terrible.
Hey, relax your hand and
keep writing.
Forget the Sticky Mucus...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呃，糟透了。
嘿，放松你的手，
继续写。
忘掉粘稠液体...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Where were we...
Cough, cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
刚才说到哪了...
咳咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah, yes. Next elements are
essential.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊，对了。接下来的材料
是必不可少的。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
10 Witched Starsand
10 Fine Grits...
Hooook, hooook~
Ekkkk, what a dusty book!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
10个女巫星沙
10个黄晶沙的一角...
呼...呼...
咳咳，这书真落灰啊！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Next is for
something hot.
1 Detonator
5 Red Blood,
and 10 Burning Hearts.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
接下来是
用来加热量的材料。
1个雷管
5个火灵矿石，
还有10个燃烧的心脏。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah, and I need
a 1, 2, or 3 carat
^ff0000Diamond^000000.
scripts.translation:

啊，对了，我还需要
1克拉、2克拉或3克拉的
^ff0000钻石^000000。

scripts.text:

Ok, I am repeating the items.
Eh, they are...

好的，我重复一下材料。
呃，它们是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I am preparing to make it,
you should get me them quickly. Cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我准备开始制作了，
你最好快点把它们弄来。咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ehhh... You came back earlier.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呃...你回来得真早。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I'm almost prepared..
Did you get
all of the items?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我快准备好了..
你把所有材料
都带来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Right, you got them all.
With this amount.. For some time...
No, to make the Secret Medicine,
These are enough, cough.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
没错，你都带来了。
以这个数量.. 够一段时间了...
不，要制作秘药，
这些足够了，咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see, we have all
that we need...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
让我看看，我们需要的
东西都齐了...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ehhhh...
Huk!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呃...
咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Cough, cough, cough!
Eh... I mean...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
咳咳咳！
呃...我是说...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Have you heard the story of
a dragon sleeping for a long time?
Next thing that I need is
something from that dragon, kkkk.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你听说过
一条沉睡了很久的龙的故事吗？
我接下来需要的东西
就来自那条龙，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You can find a funny-shaped bottle
in the dragon's lair.
It's a gourd bottle that can
contain people's speech.
I must have this.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你可以在龙巢穴找到一个
形状奇怪的瓶子。
那是一个葫芦瓶，可以
装下人们的言语。
我必须得到它。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I don't know how strong you are,
but I would like to recommend that
you avoid fighting that dragon, Kaaaaak~
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我不知道你有多强，
但我建议你
避免和那条龙战斗，咳咳~

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Then, release me.
I want to do something,
...but, my life is the priority. Yes, it is... Cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
那么，放我走吧。
我想去做点事，
...但是，我的命最重要。是的，就是这样... 咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I think
I need more, cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我想
我还需要更多，咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I am not able to do
anything without them.
I am repeating the items in the list,
you should get them all, kaaaaak!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
没有它们，我什么都做不了。
我再重复一遍清单上的物品，
你应该把它们都收集齐，咳咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
^ff000020 Grasshopper's Legs,
5 Spawn,
20 Wings Of Red Bat
10 Sticky Mucus,
10 Witch Starsand^000000...
scripts.translation:

20个 红蝙蝠翅膀

10个 魔女之星沙^000000...

scripts.text:

^ff000020 Grasshopper's Legs,
5 Spawn,
20 Wings Of Red Bat

10个 燃烧的心脏^000000

^ff0000钻石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Cough, cough.
Hu, I talked so much
that it hurts me, Kaaaak~
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
咳咳。
呼，我说了这么多，
嗓子都疼了，咳咳咳~

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is very, very hard to return alive
from a lair of a dragon
without strength and courage.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
如果没有力量和勇气，
想要从龙的巢穴活着回来，
是非常、非常困难的。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Unless you want to be killed,
you'd better forget
the magic gourd bottle, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
除非你想死，
否则最好忘掉
那个魔法的葫芦瓶，咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Akkkk?
Did you really bring it
from the lair of the dragon...?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊？
你真的从龙的巢穴
把它带回来了...？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You are superbly great.
I don't know whether
you killed the dragon or
you just stole it from the dragon,
either way I don't care.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你真是了不起。
我不知道
你是杀了那条龙，
还是直接从它那里偷来的，
反正我不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is great that
you've returned alive
from the lair of the dragon, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你能从龙的巢穴
活着回来，真是太好了，咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Here, I told you before that
this gourd bottle can
contain people's speech
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
给你，我之前告诉过你，
这个葫芦瓶可以
装下人们的言语。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
The next thing that we have to do
is to receive sincere speeches from
people with this bottle.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
接下来我们要做的，
就是用这个瓶子
收集人们真诚的言语。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
The important thing is that
you cannot force them to speak.
For example, you cannot tell them
to say 'I don't want winter to come.'
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
重要的是，
你不能强迫他们说话。
例如，你不能告诉他们
说“我不想让冬天到来”。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You should have them
speak naturally.
Ah, one more thing that
you have to take care to remember.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你应该让他们
自然地说话。
啊，还有一件事
你要特别记住。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You need to have the
voices of three people.
From a child, a young person and a
middle aged person.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你需要收集
三个人的声音。
分别来自一个孩子、一个年轻人
和一个中年人。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
The magic is not just witchcraft
This type of magic is effective
only by embodying the desires of people.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
这不仅仅是巫术。
这种魔法
只有体现人们的愿望时才有效。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Take care of yourself, cough, cough.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
保重，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is very, very hard to return alive
from a lair of a dragon
without strength and courage.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
如果没有力量和勇气，
想要从龙的巢穴活着回来，
是非常、非常困难的。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Unless you want to be killed
you'd better forget
the magic gourd bottle, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
除非你想死，
否则最好忘掉
那个魔法的葫芦瓶，咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
To make the magic,
I need you to contain
the wish phrase 'I don't want winter to come.'
from the three people, kkk.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
为了施展魔法，
我需要你收集
三个人说的愿望短语“我不想让冬天到来”，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
But, one thing that you need to remember
is, do not force them to say it!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
但是，有一件事
你需要记住，
不要强迫他们说这句话！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Next,
you should contain the word from
a child, a young man and a middle aged man.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
接下来，
你需要收集一个孩子、
一个年轻男子和一个中年男子
所说的话。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Well, take care of yourself.
Cough, cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好了，保重。
咳咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
My place has been revealed, cough, cough.
because of you!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我的藏身之处
因为你而暴露了，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
What did you do outside?
The soldiers of the Csar are
surrounding here so that
I cannot go out.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你在外面做了什么？
沙皇的士兵包围了这里，
让我无法出去。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Did you do
what I told
you to do?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你做了
我让你做的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Where is the Gourd Bottle?
I can't do anything without it.
Cough, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
葫芦瓶在哪里？
没有它我什么都做不了。
咳咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Anyway, give me the bottle and
think about
what to do, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
总之，把瓶子给我，
然后想想该怎么做，咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
This bottle will be
used later and now,
the last step remains
to complete the work.
Pass me the book.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
这个瓶子之后会用到，
现在，只剩下最后一步
来完成这项工作。
把书递给我。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
My abilities are deteriorating
and magic should only be
done by a single person.
So, you must compound the materials yourself,
kaaaaak!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我的能力正在衰退，
魔法只能由一个人施展。
所以，你必须自己混合材料，
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I know it is hard to do,
but it is the magic that
embodies and reveals
people's desires.
It is useless unless you put your
full effort into it, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我知道这很难，
但这是一种体现并揭示
人们愿望的魔法。
除非你全力以赴，否则毫无用处，咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ok, you see that book??
The letters on the book 
are illegible,
But you'll be able to read it 'cuz
I added comments under the lines for you.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好了，看到那本书了吗？
书上的字迹模糊不清，
但我在线条下添加了注释，
所以你能读懂它。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Read carefully and just follow what
it tells you.
The magic is complete.
Do your best,
Cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
仔细阅读，并按照
书上说的去做。
魔法就完成了。
加油吧，
咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Magic does not come from
something mysterious.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
魔法并不来自
什么神秘的东西。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is your effort
that makes magic.
There is a saying,
if you really want it,
it will happen, cough!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
是你的努力
造就了魔法。
有句俗话说，
如果你真的想要，
它就会实现，咳！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Here, according to the book
put the materials in the pot and
boil them for some time.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
这里，根据书上的指示，
把材料放进锅里，
煮一段时间。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ehmmm...
Don't you think that
something is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嗯...
你不觉得
有什么不对劲吗？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Well, try it again.
We still have enough materials.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好吧，再试一次。
我们还有足够的材料。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see, hmm!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
让我看看，嗯！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Hmm, this might be your first time, but
this is good.
You may be talented, kkkk.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嗯，这可能是你第一次，
但这很不错。
你可能很有天赋，哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Now then, we are in the final step.
I'll put the medicine in the bottle,
you break it by dropping it
in the center of the town.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
现在，我们到了最后一步。
我会把药水装进瓶子里，
你把它摔碎在
城镇的中心。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
If you do this, what the villagers want
will be happening,
forever.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
如果你这样做，
村民们想要的东西
就会永远实现。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You just drop the bottle
in the middle of the village
to break it.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你只需要把瓶子
摔碎在村庄的中心。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
And then,
It doesn't matter to me
if you tell the whole town or
report to the Csar to be praised.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
至于之后，
你是告诉全镇的人，
还是向凯撒汇报以求表扬，
对我来说都无所谓。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
But, don't come back to me, cough, cough.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
但是，别再回来找我了，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Hey,
I told you
to never come back, cough.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
嘿，
我说过
永远不要回来，咳咳。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Stop disturbing me.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
别打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Ah, do you accept?
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
啊，你答应了？
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Well, I thank you for your kindness.
Let's cooperate and
make my Secret Medicine.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
好吧，感谢你的好意。
让我们合作，
制作我的秘密药水。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Let me see... Ah...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
让我看看... 啊...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
It is not used often.
I don't remember
where it is.
Could you please come back later?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
这东西不常用。
我不记得
放在哪里了。
请稍后再来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Who the hell are you.
You want me to kick your ass!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你他妈是谁。
想让我揍你吗！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You, chicken,
I need to kick your ass more.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你这只小鸡，
我得好好揍你一顿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Hohoho~
You cannot beat my friends!
I don't know where you got
those Yaga Pestles, but
give them back to me!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
呵呵呵~
你打不过我的朋友们！
我不知道你从哪弄来
那些雅嘎研杵的，
但把它们还给我！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Who the hell are you?
You want me to kick your ass!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你他妈是谁？
想让我揍你吗！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I need to kick your ass more.
Come here
to play a game
Heeeeeeeeeeee
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我得好好揍你一顿。
过来
玩个游戏
嘿——————

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
No. They are...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
不。它们是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
You have our Yaga Pestles!
You have so many of them...
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你有我们的雅嘎研杵！
你有那么多...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Who, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
你，你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
I will bewitch
and enslave you.
Come here, Heeee!
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
我会施法
奴役你。
过来，嘿！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga, the Horrible]
Recently, I have no appetite.
But you will be
a good appetizer.
Come here, Heeeeeeeee.
scripts.translation:
[可怕的 芭芭雅嘎]
最近，我没有食欲。
但你会是
很好的开胃菜。
过来，嘿——————。

scripts.text:
-Beside the pot,
There is an unusually large book.
The letters are in disarray and
some of them, I can't understand.
The comments by Baba Yaga
help me read some of them.-
scripts.translation:
-在锅旁边，
有一本异常巨大的书。
上面的文字杂乱无章，
有些我看不懂。
芭芭雅嘎的批注
帮助我读懂了其中一部分。-

scripts.text: -Ok, time to read it.-
scripts.translation: -好了，该读读了。-

scripts.text:
...Therefore, this spell is
particularly good among our mighty ones.
Usually, the magic is considered
as a contract with evil.
But, the following is not the power
of Hell but of Nature and the spirit of humans.
I already told you that this spell
has 2 features as follows.
First, it changes natural phenomenon.
Unlike the idea from foolish scholars,
this world is composed of invisible and precise orders.
The things that people call
miracles are made by stimulating
them or simply altering their arrangement.
Most of the spells for weather
changing are included in them and
they require a high level of comprehension.
The orders of this world are not simply aligned.
It is almost impossible to observe
the smallest and detailed part of
them and completely understand their structure
However, it is not that difficult
to repeat the spells that are already made.
This thick spell book is for that purpose.
scripts.translation:
...因此，这个法术在我们强大的法师中尤为出色。
通常，魔法被视为与邪恶的契约。
但以下并非地狱的力量，
而是自然与人类精神的力量。
我已经告诉过你，这个法术有两个特点。
首先，它改变自然现象。
不同于愚蠢学者的想法，
这个世界由不可见且精确的秩序构成。
人们所谓的奇迹，
是通过刺激或简单改变其排列而产生的。
大多数改变天气的法术都包含在其中，
它们需要高程度的理解力。
这个世界的秩序并非简单排列。
几乎不可能观察到它们
最微小和详细的部分，
并完全理解其结构。
然而，重复已经制作好的法术
并没有那么困难。
这本厚重的法术书就是为了这个目的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That? That's just the preface?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那？那只是序言？！

scripts.text:
...The second feature is
This spell book represents the desire of mankind.
Their spirit is so great,
sometimes flames in their hearts
are embodied and become reality.
Now, practice one of the spells for weather.
You have to go to a damp and deserted place,
and have a pot of melting materials
along with the spirit of the caster.
The next spells should be conducted
through the exact process.
If you realize that something is
wrong, you'd MUST stop immediately.
To prevent the ordinary from
abusing the magic,
the narratives of the materials are metaphors,
but, whoever understands this can
read everything in it.
scripts.translation:
...第二个特点是
这本法术书代表了人类的欲望。
他们的精神如此强大，
有时心中的火焰
会具象化并成为现实。
现在，练习一个改变天气的法术。
你必须去一个潮湿且荒凉的地方，
并准备一锅正在熔化的材料，
以及施法者的精神。
接下来的法术必须
通过精确的过程进行。
如果你发现有什么不对劲，
你必须立即停止。
为了防止普通人滥用魔法，
材料的描述都是隐喻，
但，无论谁理解这一点，
都能读懂其中的一切。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It just accounts for the spell.
What a long preface.
I'll mark this spot.
so I can easily find the mixing
process next time...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它只是描述了法术。
多么长的序言啊。
我会标记这个位置，
以便下次轻松找到混合过程...

scripts.text:
^0000ffSeasonal Magic^000000:^ff0000Eternal Summer^000000
First of all, you need to put and
mix the first 3 things in a pre-heated pot.
The extended arms of those who stalk at night,
The rotten mixture of plants and animals,
and the limbs of one going forward,
who wants to run backward.
This first stage should be complete.
Just after this stage, the mixture
will barely show any alteration.
After this, you must add the liquid
that aids all life and stir 20 times.
At this point you will certainly
see its color and smell changing.
Remember that if you realize that
something is wrong, you must stop and start over.
Following these precise steps are
most important when working on magic.
Next, 2 things must be put in the pot.
First, objects that are seen when
looking at the night sky.
Second the pretty mass of earth,
slipping through even when watered.
You should check if it's smell has changed.
Then stir it well 15 times.
It's color will change.
The final ingredients will be those
that contain heat.
You must follow the order.
Stones that have the attribute of sun,
brains of a marine sphere,
the organ of passion,
and a stone that cannot be cut.
Once the final ingredient is placed in the pot,
It will be over.
The solution must be sprinkled at
the place where you want to affect,
the changing of the seasons.
scripts.translation:
^0000ff季节魔法^000000:^ff0000永恒之夏^000000
首先，你需要将前三种东西
放入预热好的锅中并混合。
那些在夜间潜遁者的伸展手臂，
植物和动物的腐朽混合物，
以及一个想要向前奔跑
却想向后跑的人的四肢。
第一阶段应该完成。
就在这一阶段之后，混合物
几乎不会显示出任何变化。
之后，你必须加入
有助于所有生命的液体，并搅拌20次。
此时你肯定会看到
它的颜色和气味发生变化。
记住，如果你发现有什么不对劲，
你必须停止并重新开始。
遵循这些精确的步骤
在施展魔法时最为重要。
接下来，必须将两样东西放入锅中。
第一，当仰望夜空时看到的物体。
第二，美丽的泥土团块，
即使浇水也会滑落。
你应该检查它的气味是否改变。
然后充分搅拌15次。
它的颜色会改变。
最后的材料将是那些
包含热量的东西。
你必须遵循顺序。
具有太阳属性的石头，
气泡虫的大脑，
激情的器官，
以及一块无法切割的石头。
一旦最后的材料放入锅中，
就结束了。
必须将溶液喷洒在
你想要影响的地方，
以改变季节。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll mark this page so that I
know where to read next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会标记这一页，
以便知道下次从哪里读起。

scripts.translation: 从序言开始阅读

scripts.text: Read from the marked page.
scripts.translation: 从标记的页面开始阅读

scripts.text:
-This book is the magic book that
helped me make the medicine, but,
I never want to read it again.-
scripts.translation:
-这本书是帮助我制作药水的魔法书，
但我再也不想读它了。-

scripts.text: -It's an unusually large book laid down, open.-
scripts.translation: -一本异常巨大的书摊开平放着。-

scripts.text:
-It is a very dirty pot.
Something is boiling
Baba Yaga might have done something
with it.
Well, let's get it started.-
scripts.translation:
-这是一个非常脏的锅。
有什么东西在沸腾。
芭芭雅嘎可能用它做了什么。
好吧，让我们开始吧。-

scripts.text:
-Something is still being boiled in the pot.
What am I going to do?-
scripts.translation:
-锅里还在煮着什么东西。
我要做什么？-

scripts.text: Put the materials in it.
scripts.translation: 放入材料

scripts.text: Pour water in it.
scripts.translation: 倒入水

scripts.text: Stir it up.
scripts.translation: 搅拌

scripts.text: It is over!
scripts.translation: 完成了！

scripts.text:
-I put the {0} in the pot.
Its smell slightly changes.-
scripts.translation:
-我把{0}放进了锅里。
它的气味稍微改变了。-

scripts.text:
-I pour water in the pot a little.
The liquid has become thin.
No other remarkable changes
have happened.-
scripts.translation:
-我往锅里倒了一点水。
液体变稀了。
没有其他明显的变化。-

scripts.text:
-I stir it up
with a stick several times.
No other remarkable changes
have happened.-
scripts.translation:
-我用木棍搅拌了几次。
没有其他明显的变化。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will tell Baba Yaga that
the work has been done.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会告诉芭芭雅嘎，工作已经完成了。

scripts.text:
-The liquid has been changed
and is now bubbling.
It seems to have shrunk,
but not by much.-
scripts.translation:
-液体发生了变化，现在正在冒泡。
看起来体积缩小了一些，但幅度不大。-

scripts.text:
-Anyway, the first step is done
let's go on the next stage.-
scripts.translation:
