scripts.text: Do you like the warm weather, little girl?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢温暖的天气吗，小女孩？

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
Yes, I like it very much~
I never want it to leave. I don't want winter to come.
scripts.translation:
[约瑟菲娜]
是的，我非常喜欢~
我希望它永远不要离开。我不希望冬天到来。

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
Yes, I like it very much~
But, as soon as the sun sets I must go back home.
scripts.translation:
[约瑟菲娜]
是的，我非常喜欢~
但是，太阳一落山我就必须回家了。

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
Baba Yaga kidnaps
bad kids wandering
in the night, I heard.
scripts.translation:
[约瑟菲娜]
我听说，芭芭雅嘎会在夜里
绑架到处乱跑的坏孩子。

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
Baba Yaga, the Horrible Cannibal
is living outside the town.
scripts.translation:
[约瑟菲娜]
可怕的食人魔芭芭雅嘎
住在城外。

scripts.text:
[Yosefina]
My mom told me.
that she is real.
scripts.translation:
[约瑟菲娜]
我妈妈告诉我的。
她说那是真的。

scripts.text: You don't like winter, do you?
scripts.translation: 你不喜欢冬天，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Fedor]
No, I don't like the cold winter.
And I get angry when
seeing couples.
scripts.translation:
[费多尔]
不，我不喜欢寒冷的冬天。
而且看到情侣在一起
我就会生气。

scripts.text:
[Fedor]
Huuuu, I wish I could have a girlfriend
I would be able to enjoy the warm sunlight better...
scripts.translation:
[费多尔]
呼...要是能有个女朋友就好了，
那样我就能更好地享受温暖的阳光了...

scripts.text:
[Fedor]
Who are you?
Don't make matters worse!
scripts.translation:
[费多尔]
你是谁？
别把事情搞得更糟！

scripts.text:
[Fedor]
Finally, winter is over.
Spring is coming
to my mind...
scripts.translation:
[费多尔]
终于，冬天过去了。
春天就要来了，
我想...

scripts.text: Whoever likes the winter?
scripts.translation: 谁喜欢冬天啊？

scripts.text:
[Viktor]
Tell me about it!
Everyone will be sad
when it comes again.
I don't want winter to come.
scripts.translation:
[维克托]
告诉我吧！
当它再次来临时，
每个人都会感到悲伤。
我不希望冬天到来。

scripts.text:
[Viktor]
Hmm, do you think so...
I am too familiar with both
summer and winter to care much for
one over the other.
scripts.translation:
[维克托]
嗯，你是这么想的吗...
我对夏天和冬天都太熟悉了，
所以并不特别偏爱哪一个。

scripts.text:
[Viktor]
Our people are very, very
proud of their strength and
invincible spirits.
scripts.translation:
[维克托]
我们的人非常、非常
自豪于自己的力量
和无敌的精神。

scripts.text:
[Viktor]
It doesn't matter to us
how cold the winter is!
scripts.translation:
[维克托]
冬天有多冷，
对我们来说并不重要！

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Wow, he is
an adventurer, an adventurer!!
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
哇，他是
冒险者，冒险者！！

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Why did you come here?
Don't you have any colleague?
I heard that the heroes in epics were tall,
but, why are you so small?
Where is your gold-shining sword?
I heard that the armor glittered white,
but, why don't you have on the armor?
Won't you go for another adventure?
How can you do it in the cold and snowy winter?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
你为什么来这里？
你没有同伴吗？
我听说史诗里的英雄都很高大，
但，你为什么这么小？
你那金光闪闪的剑在哪里？
我听说盔甲闪闪发白，
但，你为什么没穿盔甲？
你难道不再去冒险了吗？
在寒冷多雪的冬天，你怎么能那样做呢？

scripts.text: I will go if it gets warm.
scripts.translation: 天气暖和了我就去。

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Will you? I will also
go out for adventures
with shining armor and
a long and heavy sword
some day.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
真的吗？总有一天，
我也会穿着闪闪发光的盔甲，
拿着又长又重的剑
出去冒险。

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Ah, when are you leaving?
Where are you going this time?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
啊，你什么时候出发？
这次你要去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
If winter is gone,
it is much easier to go on adventures.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
如果冬天过去了，
去冒险就容易多了。

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Will you go to slay the dragon,
that breathes fire and can
exterminates 10 men by flapping
its wings once?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
你会去屠龙吗？
就是那种会喷火，
扇一次翅膀就能消灭十个人的龙？

scripts.text:
[Vasili]
Tell me your exciting story.
Have you fought a dragon?
Where is your gold-shining sword and shield?
Where?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里]
快讲讲你精彩的冒险故事吧！
你打败过龙吗？
你那闪闪发光的剑和盾在哪里？
在哪里？

scripts.text: You look good today.
scripts.translation: 你今天看起来气色不错。

scripts.text:
[Katya]
Yes, I feel good.
When it gets warm, sunflowers bloom.
The sunflower is the symbol
of this province.
scripts.translation:
[卡佳]
是啊，我感觉很好。
天气暖和了，向日葵就开了。
向日葵是这个省份的象征。

scripts.text:
[Katya]
I wish that winter never comes back and
I could see sunflowers everyday.
scripts.translation:
[卡佳]
我希望冬天永远不要再来，
这样我就能天天看到向日葵了。

scripts.text:
[Katya]
The spring has come~
scripts.translation:
[卡佳]
春天来了~

scripts.text:
[Katya]
A million sunflowers are blooming~
scripts.translation:
[卡佳]
一百万朵向日葵都开了~

scripts.text: The weather is getting warmer.
scripts.translation: 天气越来越暖和了。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
Yes, kids like it and
flowers are blooming.
scripts.translation:
[罗扎]
是啊，孩子们很喜欢，
花儿也开了。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
In the warm days,
I'm in trouble.
It's too hard to control
the children.
scripts.translation:
[罗扎]
在暖和的日子里，
我有点头疼。
太难管住那些孩子了。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
Whoever likes the cold and dark winter?
I hope this weather last forever.
scripts.translation:
[罗扎]
谁喜欢寒冷黑暗的冬天呢？
我希望这种天气能永远持续下去。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
I think
I need winter again.
scripts.translation:
[罗扎]
我觉得
我还是需要冬天。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
Naughty children get too
excited in the warm days.
scripts.translation:
[罗扎]
调皮的孩子们在暖和的日子里
太兴奋了。

scripts.text:
[Roza]
Where is the sun?
Where is it hiding?
scripts.translation:
[罗扎]
太阳在哪里？
它躲到哪里去了？

scripts.text: Do you like mysterious stories?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢神秘的故事吗？

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
Yes, I love them.
But, in winter,
nobody comes out of their homes.
So it's not very fun.
scripts.translation:
[费利克斯]
是的，我很喜欢。
但是，在冬天，
没人会出门。
所以不太好玩。

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
Yes, my Grandma told me
fairy-tales.
The winter is cold, but
it is fun to hear them.
scripts.translation:
[费利克斯]
是的，我的老奶奶
给我讲过童话。
冬天虽然冷，
但听故事很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
If winter never comes
I can have
fun all the time...
scripts.translation:
[费利克斯]
如果冬天永远不来，
我就可以
一直玩下去了...

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
This is the story
about a terrible dragon.
scripts.translation:
[费利克斯]
这是一个
关于可怕巨龙的故事。

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
It is sleeping
in its lair,
but, it destroys everything
around it when it awakes.
scripts.translation:
[费利克斯]
它正在巢穴里睡觉，
但一旦醒来，
就会摧毁周围的一切。

scripts.text:
[Feliks]
This came from my grandma's
grandma's grandma's
grandma's grandma's
grandma's grandma.
scripts.translation:
[费利克斯]
这个故事来自我奶奶的
奶奶的奶奶的
奶奶的奶奶的
奶奶的奶奶。

scripts.text:
[Ilyav]
I am going to adventure
to experience new worlds
as you do.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚夫]
我要去冒险，
像你们一样，
去体验新的世界。

scripts.text: When do you feel good?
scripts.translation: 你什么时候心情好？

scripts.text:
[Ilyav]
When the weather is as good as recently
I feel an impulse to adventure
many times a day.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚夫]
当天气像最近这样好的时候，
我一天会有好几次
想要去冒险的冲动。

scripts.text:
[Ilyav]
Well...
I don't know.
I just am sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚夫]
嗯...
我也说不清。
只是有时候会这样。

scripts.text:
[Ilyav]
But, I don't want to in the cold winter.
Hu, if the weather everday was as good as lately,
I would like to go out a lot more.
I hate winter...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亚夫]
但是，我不想在寒冷的冬天出门。
呼，如果每天天气都像最近这样好，
我就更想多出去走走了。
我讨厌冬天...

scripts.text: What do you usually do in winter?
scripts.translation: 你冬天通常做什么？

scripts.text:
[Orek]
It is too cold in winter so I don't go outside.
There's so much snow that it makes it hard to go
around here and there.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷克]
冬天太冷了，所以我不出门。
雪太大了，
让人很难到处走动。

scripts.text:
[Orek]
It snows a lot in winter and
gets too cold.
So, we don't go outside
without a particular reason.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷克]
冬天雪下得很大，
而且太冷了。
所以，没有特别的原因，
我们不会出门。

scripts.text:
[Orek]
In winter, fishing is more difficult,
anyway, it is bad for us.
I think it would be ok if we never had winter again.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷克]
冬天钓鱼更难了，
总之，这对我们很不利。
我想，如果再也没有冬天就好了。

scripts.text:
[Orek]
My family just sits beside the pechka and talks,
hoping that winter passes by soon.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷克]
我的家人只是坐在壁炉旁聊天，
希望冬天快点过去。

scripts.text:
[Orek]
The present Csar is a bit strict and
terrible, but
he actually loves
his people.
scripts.translation:
[奥雷克]
现在的沙皇有点严厉，
甚至有点可怕，
但他其实
很爱他的人民。

scripts.text:
[Kyra]
I've seen many people
from other provinces recently.
scripts.translation:
[基拉]
最近我见到很多
来自其他省份的人。

scripts.text:
[Kyra]
This used to not
be a tourist town.
What happened...?
scripts.translation:
[基拉]
这里以前
并不是旅游城镇。
发生了什么事...？

scripts.text: Here it is warm and good.
scripts.translation: 这里温暖又舒适。

scripts.text:
[Kyra]
Hohoho, that may be true now.
But, you don't even know how cold it gets here in winter.
You wouldn't even want to go outside.
scripts.translation:
[基拉]
呵呵呵，现在也许是这样。
但你不知道这里冬天有多冷。
你甚至不想出门。

scripts.text:
[Kyra]
It is good to stay with my family, but
nobody likes the cold winter.
scripts.translation:
[基拉]
和家人待在一起很好，
但没有人喜欢寒冷的冬天。

scripts.text:
[Sabina]
Sunflowers are squeezed for oil and
their bodies are used for medicinal purposes.
They are very useful.
scripts.translation:
[萨宾娜]
向日葵被榨油，
它们的身体被用于药用。
它们非常有用。

scripts.text: When do sunflowers bloom?
scripts.translation: 向日葵什么时候开花？

scripts.text:
[Sabina]
They start to bloom
from the late summer.
You cannot help being
attracted to sunflowers,
if you see the spectacular scene
of a field filled up with them.
scripts.translation:
[萨宾娜]
它们从夏末开始开花。
如果你看到
一片开满向日葵的壮观景象，
你无法不被它们吸引。

scripts.text:
[Sabina]
If the summer continues to last,
I can see them all the time...
scripts.translation:
[萨宾娜]
如果夏天能一直持续，
我就可以一直看到它们了...

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
There is a old saying,
'an opportunity is a chance.'
scripts.translation:
[伊兹洛夫]
有句老话，
“机会就是机遇。”

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
It is best to confess
to ladies in the warm weather,
when their minds wander
right now!
scripts.translation:
[伊兹洛夫]
在温暖的天气里向女士们表白最好，
因为她们的心思
现在正四处游荡呢！

scripts.text: It's good to have warm weather.
scripts.translation: 温暖的天气真好。

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
Of course.
From now on, it is my golden age of opportunity!
scripts.translation:
[伊兹洛夫]
当然。
从现在起，就是我的黄金机遇期了！

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
Of course.
The cold winter has gone.
From now on, it is my golden age!
scripts.translation:
[伊兹洛夫]
当然。
寒冷的冬天已经过去了。
从现在起，就是我的黄金时期！

scripts.text:
[Izlof]
If it is the summer all the time,
my life will be in an amorous mood.
Hahaha!
I don't want winter to come.
scripts.translation:
[伊兹洛夫]
如果永远是夏天，
我的生活就会充满情调。
哈哈哈！
我不希望冬天到来。

scripts.text:
[Lev]
I was once like you,
with a hot heart and cool reason,
adventuring everywhere and
coping with all the troubles...
scripts.translation:
[列夫]
我曾经也像你一样，
热血而理智，
四处冒险，
应对所有的麻烦...

scripts.text: You need to take a rest.
scripts.translation: 你需要休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Lev]
Yes, under the warm sunlight,
I like to rest.
scripts.translation:
[列夫]
是的，在温暖的阳光下，
我喜欢休息。

scripts.text:
[Lev]
I hope that this warm weather
will last forever.
I hate the cold winter.
scripts.translation:
[列夫]
我希望这温暖的天气
能永远持续下去。
我讨厌寒冷的冬天。

scripts.text:
[Lev]
But, I am still alive!
I don't want to hear talk
like that from you.
scripts.translation:
[列夫]
但是，我还活着！
我不想听你
说那种话。

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
The men here grow up
after going through tough waves in
the vast sea
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
这里的男人们
在浩瀚的大海中
经历风浪后成长起来

scripts.text: However, if winter comes...
scripts.translation: 不过，如果冬天来了...

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
Yes, in winter the
sea is frozen, so it
is impossible to sail.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
是的，冬天大海会结冰，
所以无法航行。

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
Although I won't be able
to sail, my passion is not
cooled down from winter.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
虽然冬天无法航行，
但我的热情
不会因为冬天而冷却。

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
I hope that winter never comes.
It is my dream.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
我希望冬天永远不要来。
这是我的梦想。

scripts.text:
[Fredek]
Do you like
sailing?
scripts.translation:
[弗雷德克]
你喜欢
航海吗？

scripts.text:
[Gavrel]
Don't you think that the castle is magnificent?
It was built by my great great grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[加夫列尔]
你不觉得这座城堡很宏伟吗？
它是由我的曾曾祖父建造的。

scripts.text:
[Gavrel]
It is very strong and
it is warm inside of it.
I am very proud of it.
scripts.translation:
[加夫列尔]
它非常坚固，
里面也很温暖。
我为此感到非常自豪。

scripts.text: Is it cold much in winter?
scripts.translation: 冬天会很冷吗？

scripts.text:
[Gavrel]
Yes, it is very cold.
If you didn't prepare,
it would be hard for you.
scripts.translation:
[加夫列尔]
是的，非常冷。
如果你没有做好准备，
那会很难熬的。

scripts.text:
[Gavrel]
It would be a lot better
if winter never came again.
But, design of coldness is
winter itself, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[加夫列尔]
如果冬天再也不来了就好了。
但寒冷的设计，
不正是冬天本身吗？

scripts.text: Do you like summer?
scripts.translation: 你喜欢夏天吗？

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
Ah, move a bit to the side.
a bit more... Yes.
Ah, stop there.
scripts.translation:
[留里克]
啊，稍微往旁边挪一点。
再一点... 是的。
啊，就停在那里。

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
Sure, I like the summer.
Why are you asking
such a question so suddenly?
scripts.translation:
[留里克]
当然，我喜欢夏天。
你为什么突然
问这种问题？

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
I certainly like the summer.
Unless the sunlight is too strong,
it is much better than the cold winter.
scripts.translation:
[留里克]
我确实喜欢夏天。
只要阳光不是太强，
它比寒冷的冬天好多了。

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
By the way, what is this for?
It is natural to like the summer.
Do you think
the winter should come again?
scripts.translation:
[留里克]
顺便问一下，这是为了什么？
喜欢夏天是很自然的。
你觉得
冬天应该再来吗？

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
It's hard to look up at you.
Come lower so I can see your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[留里克]
仰视你有点累。
下来一点，让我看看你的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Rurik]
Hmm, that's better.
Children are the future.
I won't have a future if I fall
back and hurt my neck
while looking up at you.
scripts.translation:
[留里克]
嗯，这样好多了。
孩子是未来。
如果我仰视你时
向后摔倒伤了脖子，
我就没有未来了。

scripts.text:
-There are ugly skulls
all over here but, 
this is the only place that I can stay.-
scripts.translation:
-这里到处都是丑陋的头骨，
但这是我能待的唯一地方。-

scripts.text:
-Get closer to see
more carefully.-
scripts.translation: -走近一点仔细看看。-

scripts.text: -The ugly skulls are gathered.-
scripts.translation: -丑陋的头骨聚集在一起。-

scripts.text:
-She said that the Magic Gourd Bottle that
can hold people's speech
is around here.-
scripts.translation:
-她说能装下人们话语的
魔法的葫芦瓶就在附近。-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is probably the only place
where the bottle is hidden,
but there are bones all over.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这大概是瓶子藏身的唯一地方，
但到处都是骨头。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, why am I here?
It would be trouble if
the dragon came back...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
总之，我为什么在这里？
如果龙回来的话...
那就麻烦了...

scripts.text: Look for it.
scripts.translation: 寻找它

scripts.text: I will try next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再试

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here it is.
That was easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在这里。
找起来还挺容易的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, I got it!
I better get out of here quickly.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，拿到了！
我得赶紧离开这里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where the hell is it?!
It has to be in here somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
该死，它在哪里？！
它肯定就在某个地方！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will try later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我稍后再试。

scripts.text:
Wait a moment!!
You have too many items.
You can't receive this.
Lighten your weight and
try again.
scripts.translation:
请稍等！！
您的物品栏已满。
无法接收此物品。
请减轻负重后重试。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Hello, foreign traveler!
Have you had good day
in Moscovia?
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
你好，外来的旅行者！
在莫斯科比亚过得愉快吗？

scripts.text:
[Irina]
A special souvenir for visiting Moscovia...?
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
来莫斯科比亚游玩的特别纪念品...？

scripts.text:
[Irina]
For you, let's make a Shafka hat.
The Shafka has practicality and
it's spruce! Do you want one?
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
为了你，我们来做一顶遮耳帽吧。
遮耳帽既实用又精神！你想要一顶吗？

scripts.text: Learn about the Shafka.
scripts.translation: 了解遮耳帽

scripts.text: Make a Shafka hat.
scripts.translation: 制作遮耳帽

scripts.text:
[Irina]
When I look at you, you seem to
want to put on something of a thick
fur hat on your head, out in this
temperature. A Shafka!
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
看着你，似乎很想在这种气温下
戴一顶厚实的毛皮帽子。遮耳帽！

scripts.text:
[Irina]
If you've come here for the first
time, you might not know... that
winter here is famous for being so
long and cold in Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
如果你是第一次来这里，可能还不知道...
莫斯科比亚的冬天以漫长和寒冷而闻名。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
A Shafka hat is especially
necessary to live here during the
cold seasons. Without this hat, you
may not endure a winter!
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
在寒冷的季节生活在这里，
遮耳帽是特别必要的。没有这顶帽子，
你可能无法熬过冬天！

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Now, the long, long winter has
ended and the sun is shining... But
someday the winter will come again.
So, for preparation, you should
keep a Shafka hat handy.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
现在，漫长漫长的冬天结束了，
阳光普照...但总有一天冬天会再次来临。
所以，为了做好准备，
你应该常备一顶遮耳帽。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Don't worry about keeping warm if
you're wearing a Shafka hat. Even
during the coldest weather... You
can roll around in the snow and the
Shafka still keeps you warm!
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
戴着遮耳帽就不用担心保暖了。
即使在最寒冷的天气里...
你可以在雪地里打滚，
遮耳帽依然能保持温暖！

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Do you want to make a Shafka hat?
Heheh. Good idea!
That's a good task.
You will be grateful forever.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
你想制作一顶遮耳帽吗？
呵呵。好主意！
这是个不错的任务。
你会永远感激的。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
If you bring the materials,
we can make one immediately!
The materials are: ^0000FFNine Tails 20, Yarn 10, Soft Silk 10, Sea-otter Fur 20, Spool 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
如果你带来材料，
我们可以立刻制作！
材料是：^0000FF九尾狐 20, 毛线 10, 柔软的绸缎布 10, 海獭的皮革 20, 线轴 1^000000。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
You did well.
Give me the materials. I will make the Shafka.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
你做得很好。
把材料给我。我来制作遮耳帽。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Good, I made it. So, how about it?
Do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
很好，我做好了。那么，感觉如何？
你喜欢吗？

scripts.text:
[Irina]
If you need a Shafka hat,
come to me whenever,
with the materials.
I will make it.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
如果你需要遮耳帽，
随时带着材料来找我。
我会为你制作。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Okay?
Okay, so... Bye-bye!~
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
好吗？
好的，那么...再见！~

scripts.text:
[Irina]
Ah... You lack some materials. We
can't make the Shafka hat with just
these materials.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
啊...你缺少一些材料。仅凭这些材料
我们无法制作遮耳帽。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
If you bring the right materials, I
will make a Shafka immediately.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
如果你带来正确的材料，
我会立刻为你制作遮耳帽。

scripts.text:
[Irina]
The materials are: ^0000FFNine Tails 20, Yarn 10, Soft Silk 10, Sea-otter Fur 20, Spool 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊琳娜]
材料是：^0000FF九尾狐 20, 毛线 10, 柔软的绸缎布 10, 海獭的皮革 20, 线轴 1^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Ah, a foreigner,
you're not from
around here are you?
It's nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
啊，你是外乡人吧？
看来你不是这里的人。
很高兴见到你！

scripts.text:
[Sage]
I've heard stories of the many adventurers from your lands. But, I haven't been able to talk with them much because they were always busy.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
我听说过许多来自你们那里的冒险者的故事。不过，因为他们总是很忙，所以我没机会和他们多聊几句。

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy.....
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙...

scripts.text: Ok, let's talk.
scripts.translation: 好的，我们聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Ah, you are...
I just wanted to hear about news from other lands...
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
啊，你是...
我只是想听听其他地方的消息...

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Sorry to bother you. You have a good trip.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
抱歉打扰你了。祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
I've heard that interesting creatures inhabit your lands. Could you please tell me about at least one of them?
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
我听说你们那里栖息着一些有趣的生物。能请你至少给我讲讲其中一种吗？

scripts.text: Show him a Poring Card
scripts.translation: 给他看一张波利卡片

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is a card of one of the monsters that inhabit the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是米德加尔特大陆上栖息的一种魔物的卡片。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
...?!
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
...？！
你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah.. haha.. where is it?!
W, wait.. I've got one somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊..哈哈..它在哪里？！
等，等等..我好像有一张！

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Hooh, it is.. I can't believe this is real.
Thank you for showing me this.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
哦，原来如此..真不敢相信这是真的。
谢谢你给我看这个。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
By the way, do you like this place?
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
顺便问一下，你喜欢这个地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Now, that winter has passed and summer is coming the weather is great. And I know that winter comes every year, but I always pray that it won't return again.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
现在冬天过去了，夏天即将到来，天气很好。虽然我知道每年冬天都会回来，但我总是祈祷它不要再来了。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
After the passing of winter, the summer weather has made the forest dense and the air so warm. My favorite season will always be summer.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
冬天过后，夏天的天气让森林变得茂密，空气也温暖起来。我最喜欢的季节永远是夏天。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
But, don't forget that you should still be careful. Lots of adventurers were lost in the forst in front of us.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
但是，别忘了你还是要小心。在我们面前的森林里，有很多冒险者迷路了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Have any of the adventurers returned?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有冒险者回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Only one has come back and told me of a mysterious stone, where the road splits into three, that curses those who touch it so I've been keeping away from it.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
只有一人回来了，他告诉我在一处道路分岔成三的地方有一块神秘的石头，触摸它的人会遭到诅咒，所以我一直避开那里。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
But, don't worry about me. I know my way around here and am not afraid of monsters, haha.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
不过，别担心我。我对这里很熟悉，也不怕魔物，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Now, that winter has passed and summer is coming the weather is great. And I know that winter comes every year, but I always pray that it won't return again.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
现在冬天过去了，夏天即将到来，天气很好。虽然我知道每年冬天都会回来，但我总是祈祷它不要再来了。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
After the passing of winter, the summer weather has made the forest dense and the air so warm. My favorite season will always be summer.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
冬天过后，夏天的天气让森林变得茂密，空气也温暖起来。我最喜欢的季节永远是夏天。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
But, don't forget that you should still be careful. Lots of adventurers were lost in the forst in front of us.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
但是，别忘了你还是要小心。在我们面前的森林里，有很多冒险者迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Only one has come back and told me of a mysterious stone, where the road splits into three, that curses those who touch it so I've been keeping away from it.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
只有一人回来了，他告诉我在一处道路分岔成三的地方有一块神秘的石头，触摸它的人会遭到诅咒，所以我一直避开那里。

scripts.text:
[Sage]
Me? Haha, don't worry about me. I know my way around here and am not afraid of monsters, haha.
scripts.translation:
[贤者]
我？哈哈，别担心我。我对这里很熟悉，也不怕魔物，哈哈。

scripts.text: - The road forks here -
scripts.translation: - 道路在此分岔 -

scripts.text:
- Words are engraved -
- on the stone -
scripts.translation: - 石头上刻着文字 -

scripts.text:
- Right path -> Drain -
- Left path -> Curse -
- Middle -> ? -
scripts.translation:
- 右路 -> 吸取 -
- 左路 -> 诅咒 -
- 中路 -> ? -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Where should I go?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我该走哪条路？

scripts.text: Right
scripts.translation: 右路

scripts.text: Left
scripts.translation: 左路

scripts.text: Middle
scripts.translation: 中路

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...What about the right...
- You decide to go to the right -
scripts.translation: - 你决定向右走 -

scripts.text:
- An unknown force has -
- drained your health -
scripts.translation:
- 一股未知的力量 -
- 吸取了你的生命值 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...What about the left...?
- You decide to go to the left -
scripts.translation: - 你决定向左走 -

scripts.text:
- An unknown force has -
- cursed your body -
scripts.translation:
- 一股未知的力量 -
- 诅咒了你的身体 -

scripts.text: - You decide to go to the left -
scripts.translation: - 你决定向左走 -

scripts.text:
- Your trusty Pecopeco senses -
- an unknown force and tries -
- to run away!! -
scripts.translation:
- 你信任的大嘴鸟 -
- 察觉到了未知的力量 -
- 并试图逃跑！！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...What about the middle...?

- You move forward -
- toward the middle -
scripts.translation:
- 你向中间 -
- 前进 -

scripts.text:
- Words are engraved -
- on the stone -
scripts.translation: - 石头上刻着文字 -

scripts.text:
- Right path -> Drain -
- Left path -> Curse -
- Middle -> ? -
scripts.translation:
- 右路 -> 吸取 -
- 左路 -> 诅咒 -
- 中路 -> ? -

scripts.text:
- You carefully read the stone -
- and decide to wait -
scripts.translation:
- 你仔细阅读石头上的文字 -
- 并决定等待 -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
... Turn back, adventurer...
This is not where you belong.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
...回去吧，冒险者...
这里不是你该来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Halt, adventurer.
Why did you disregard the warnings on the stone?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
站住，冒险者。
你为何无视石头上的警告？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you the reason adventurers are getting lost around this forest?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
难道你就是导致冒险者在这片森林迷路的原因吗？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
...lost around this forest.
He doesn't want anyone to wander around the forest.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
...迷路在这片森林。
他不想让任何人在这片森林徘徊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He? Who is he?!

[Gray Wolf]
His name is Koshei, the Immortal...
and he has been freed from his captivity... You'd better leave before he finds you.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
他的名字是不死者 科舍伊...
而且他已经被释放了...你最好在他发现你之前离开。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
I'm warning you again!
Unless you want to be killed, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
我再警告你一次！
除非你想死，否则现在就离开。

scripts.text:
- The Gray Wolf attacks you -
- with it's claws and jumps -
- into the bushes behind you!! -
scripts.translation:
- 灰狼向你发起攻击 -
- 它挥舞着利爪 -
- 跳进了你身后的灌木丛里！！ -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
...Why did you come back?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
...你为什么又回来了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am afraid of nothing!
I'm not afraid of your warning 'cuz I'm not as weak as you think I am!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我什么都不怕！
我不怕你的警告，因为我并不像你想象的那么弱！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your attack from before was a cheapshot! If you have something to do with the missing people around here, you won't be forgiven!
Come on!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你刚才的攻击是偷袭！如果你和这里失踪的人有关，我绝不会原谅你！
来吧！！！

scripts.text:
- You stand firm and -
- aim your weapon -
- at the Gray Wolf -
scripts.translation:
- 你坚定地站着 -
- 举起武器 -
- 对准灰狼 -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Stop it. You cannot beat me.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
住手。你打不过我的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see who's stronger?!
Take your position. I won't take you by surprise!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
让我们看看谁更强吧？！
摆好架势。我不会偷袭你的！！！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
......You...... Haha.....
Hahahahaha!!

[Gray Wolf]
Yes, you are very brave.
... Yes, I think that I've been waiting for someone like you.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
是的，你很勇敢。
... 是的，我想我一直在等待像你这样的人。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Please accept my apologies.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
请接受我的道歉。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
I need brave adventurers, like you, to help me. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
我需要像你这样勇敢的冒险者来帮我。你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: No, how can I trust you?
scripts.translation: 不，我怎么能信任你？

scripts.text: Ok, I'll help
scripts.translation: 好，我帮你

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Hu.. you won't. But, I ask you again. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
呼.. 你拒绝了我。但我再问一次。你能帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... Ok, ok. There's no way I can refuse this type of request.
So, what do you want me to do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...好吧，好吧。这种请求我没法拒绝。
那么，你想让我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
This isn't a good place to talk. Get on my back, I will show you something.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
这里不是说话的好地方。骑到我背上来，我带你去看样东西。

scripts.text:
- He turns his back to me -
- I jump up and suddenly -
scripts.translation:
- 他转过身去 -
- 我跳上去，突然 -

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Who is there? Gray Wolf?!
Wolf, who are you with?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
谁在那里？灰狼？！
狼，你带着谁？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
This is an adventurer from another land. He is not afraid of Koshei. He may be able to help you.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
这是一位来自异乡的冒险者。他并不害怕科斯赫伊。也许他能帮到你。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Help me? Do you think he can stop Koshei?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
帮我？你觉得他能阻止科斯赫伊吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, hold on. Who is Koshei and who is talking?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，等一下。科斯赫伊是谁？还有，是谁在说话？

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Koshei.. He is an immortal and endless evil. I fought against him a long tim ago. After a fierce fight, I had to seal him in the darkness because he is immortal.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
科斯赫伊...他是永生不灭的邪恶。很久以前我曾与他战斗。经过一场激战，我不得不将他封印在黑暗中，因为他是不死的。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
And as a result I became imprisoned in this wall.
He has found a way to break away from his seal and I fear for the worst.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
结果我也被囚禁在这面墙里。
他找到了打破封印的方法，我担心最坏的情况会发生。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
My name is Maria Morebna. Help me exterminate Koshei. I want to keep peace in Moscovia. Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
我叫玛丽亚·莫雷布娜。帮我消灭科斯赫伊。我想让莫斯科比亚保持和平。你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: Ok, I can
scripts.translation: 好，我可以

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，我该怎么帮你？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
First, you need to find a way to get her out of there.
I've heard about a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything. There is a keymaker in town.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
首先，你需要找到把她从那里弄出来的方法。
我听说有一把'^0000ff黄金色钥匙^000000'，它能打开任何东西。镇上有一位锁匠。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
As you see, I look like a monster so I am not able to go there. I want you to find this keymaker and ask about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
你也看到了，我看起来像魔物，所以我无法去那里。我想让你去找这位锁匠，问问关于'^0000ff黄金色钥匙^000000'的事。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Please don't forget about me.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
请别忘了我。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Help me get out of here.
I hope you can help me find that '^0000ffGolden Key^000000' that can open anything.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
帮我把我从这里弄出去。
我希望你能帮我找到那把能打开任何东西的'^0000ff黄金色钥匙^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
I've heard about a keymaker in Moscovia who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
我听说莫斯科比亚有一位锁匠，他知道如何制作'^0000ff黄金色钥匙^000000'。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什么...？

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Did you get the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
你拿到钥匙了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...I need golden thread. I heard that I was able to get it from Marozka. He....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...我需要金线。我听说可以从马罗兹卡那里得到。他....

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Marozka... He is the owner of winter and dwells in the deep underground. He won't let just anyone see him.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
马罗兹卡...他是冬天的主人，居住在深深的地下。他不会让随便什么人见到他。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
He has monsters that guard his underground lair. It's very dangerous. But, I know where he is.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
他有魔物守卫着地下的巢穴。那里非常危险。但是，我知道他在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
What do you think? I can open a portal to the cave Do you want to go there now?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
你觉得怎么样？我可以打开一个通往洞穴的传送门。你想现在去那里吗？

scripts.text: Not yet...
scripts.translation: 还没...

scripts.text: Open the portal!
scripts.translation: 打开传送门！

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
... When you're ready, just tell me.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
...当你准备好的时候，告诉我一声。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
...Ok, be careful There are a lot of monsters there.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
...好的，小心点。那里有很多魔物。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Have you.. got the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
你...拿到钥匙了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not yet... Give me a second.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还没有...请给我一点时间。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
If you gather all the necessary things, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
如果你收集齐了所有必要的东西，就去莫斯科比亚找那位锁匠。请帮我这个忙。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Have you.. got the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
你...拿到钥匙了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I collected every meterial for the key, But have not yet got the key...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我收集齐了制作钥匙的所有材料，但还没有拿到钥匙...

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Go to Moscovia and find the keymaker.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
去莫斯科比亚找那位锁匠。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not yet... Give me a second.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还没有...请给我一点时间。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
If you gather all the things necessary, go to Moscovia and find the keymaker. Do me this favor, please.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
如果你收集齐了所有必要的东西，就去莫斯科比亚找那位锁匠。请帮我这个忙。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
I can feel Koshei's energy.. It is not a time to use the key...
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
我能感觉到科谢伊的能量...现在不是使用钥匙的时候...

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Did you get the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
你拿到钥匙了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I did. So, how do I use it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我做到了。那么，我该怎么使用它？

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Listen very carefully!
Left the key up, and shout '^0000ffThe Free wind blows and gets you wherever you want^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
请仔细听！
举起钥匙，然后大喊'^0000ff自由的风会把你吹向任何你想去的地方^000000'。

scripts.text:
- The key begins to glow -
- wind begins to blow -
- from somewhere -
scripts.translation:
- 钥匙开始发光 -
- 风开始吹起 -
- 从某个地方 -

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
You must've said it wrong...
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
你肯定念错了...

scripts.text:
- The wind disappears and -
- a very young girl appears -
scripts.translation:
- 风消失了 -
- 一个非常年幼的女孩出现了 -

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Thank you!
I'm finally out of there! Now I can.....................aaaaak!!!....
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
谢谢你！
我终于出来了！现在我可以.....................啊啊啊！！！....

scripts.text:
- Maria is attacked -
- and falls down!! -
scripts.translation:
- 玛丽亚遭到攻击 -
- 倒下了！！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Maria?! What happened?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
玛丽亚？！发生什么了？！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
I really want to thank you, human. Maria was imprisoned in the wall so I couldn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
我真想谢谢你，人类。玛丽亚被囚禁在墙里，我什么都做不了！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
She'll thank me for giving her a quick death!!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
她一定会感谢我给了她一个痛快的死法！！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
But you, human... You are here to disturb me?
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
但是，人类...你是来打扰我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
No one can stop me! Now, die!!!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
没有人能阻止我！现在，去死吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Watch out!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
小心！！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
Gray Wolf...
You think you can fight me?!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
灰狼...
你以为你能打败我？！

scripts.text:
- Staggering from -
- Koshei's flames, -
- Gray Wolf quickly tell me -
scripts.translation:
- 灰狼被科舍伊的火焰 -
- 逼得踉跄后退， -
- 它迅速对我说 -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Listen, I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
听着，如果我现在就治疗她，我还能救玛丽亚。
我会带着她逃走，留你一个人去对付科舍伊！！

scripts.text:
[Koshei, the Immortal]
Stop! Where do you think you're going?!!!
scripts.translation:
[不死者 科舍伊]
站住！你以为你能逃到哪里去？！！！

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Have you.. got the key?
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
你...拿到钥匙了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can sense Koshei's presence.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的声音]
我能感觉到科舍伊的存在。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的声音]
如果我现在就治疗她，我还能救玛丽亚。
我会带着她逃走，留你一个人去对付科舍伊！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Maria...
I... could do nothing...

[Gray Wolf]
No, it's not too late!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
不，还不算太晚！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
She's alive.
But, she's still unstable.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
她还活着。
但是，她的情况仍然不稳定。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
To save her, I need 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'. Find Baba Yaga, she'll know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
要救她，我需要“生命之水”和“死亡之水”。去找芭芭雅嘎，她会知道该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
I can't keep her alive for much longer. You must find Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
我撑不了太久了。你必须找到芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
But, she's still unstable.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的声音]
但是，她的情况仍然不稳定。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
To save her, I need 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'. Find Baba Yaga, she'll know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的声音]
要救她，我需要“生命之水”和“死亡之水”。去找芭芭雅嘎，她会知道该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can't keep her alive for much longer. You must find Baba Yaga.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的声音]
我撑不了太久了。你必须找到芭芭雅嘎。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can sense Koshei's presence.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的声音]
我能感觉到科舍伊的存在。

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
I can still help Maria if I treat her now.
I will flee with her and leave you to deal with Koshei!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的声音]
如果我现在就治疗她，我还能救玛丽亚。
我会带着她逃走，留你一个人去对付科舍伊！！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf's voice]
Did you get the 'Life Water' and 'Death Water'?
scripts.translation:
[灰狼的声音]
你拿到“生命之水”和“死亡之水”了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've got them! How's Maria?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了！玛丽亚怎么样了？！

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
I fear that her spirit has gone. Severe wounds and curses are hindering her spirit from coming back. But we can save her with that water.
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
恐怕她的灵魂已经离开了。严重的伤势和诅咒阻碍了她的灵魂回归。但我们可以用那些水来救她。

scripts.text: Death Water
scripts.translation: 死亡之水

scripts.text: Life Water
scripts.translation: 生命之水

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I hope this works...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希望这能管用...

scripts.text:
- I pour the Death Water -
- on Maria's stiff body -
scripts.translation:
- 我将死亡之水 -
- 倒在玛丽亚僵硬的身体上 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I hope this works...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希望这能管用...

scripts.text:
- I pour the Life Water -
- on Maria's stiff body -
scripts.translation:
- 我将生命之水 -
- 倒在玛丽亚僵硬的身体上 -

scripts.text: - Nothing changed -
scripts.translation: - 没有任何变化 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huk, was this wrong...?!

[Gray Wolf]
What are you doing?! I told you we did not have much time! What are you going to do now?!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
你在干什么？！我告诉过我们时间不多了！你现在打算怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am so sorry. But some water is left...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
非常抱歉。但还剩下一些水...

scripts.text:
- The wounds and -
- curses on her body -
- are removed !! -
scripts.translation:
- 她身上的伤口 -
- 和诅咒 -
- 都被消除了！！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok! Next...
Death Water
scripts.translation: 死亡之水

scripts.text: Life Water
scripts.translation: 生命之水

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pour the 'Death Water' again...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
再次倒入“死亡之水”...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...!? No, not 'Death Water'.. I should pour 'Life Water'.......

[{0}]
Hehehe, you can trust me. Next is the 'Life Water'.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呵呵呵，你可以信任我。接下来是“生命之水”。

scripts.text: - I pour 'Life Water' on Maria -
scripts.translation: - 我将“生命之水”倒在玛丽亚身上 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, next the 'Life Water'.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，接下来是“生命之水”。

scripts.text:
- I pour the Life Water -
- on Maria's stiff body  -
scripts.translation:
- 我将生命之水 -
- 倒在玛丽亚僵硬的身体上 -

scripts.text:
[Gray Wolf]
Success!!
scripts.translation:
[灰狼]
成功了！！

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Ah, did I...?!
You saved me. I really appreicate it. Thank you for helping us fight against Koshei.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
啊，我...？！
你救了我。我非常感激。谢谢你帮助我们对抗科斯海。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
And you, Gray Wolf.. Thank you for protecting me while I was helpless.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
还有你，灰狼...谢谢你在我无助的时候保护我。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Koshei wasn't completely destroyed. But, his power has weakened, it shouldn't be hard to seal his power without me also being sealed.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
科斯海并没有被完全消灭。但他的力量已经减弱，即使没有我也应该不难封印他的力量。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Koshei and I are bound by magic. If one's power should be sealed, the other must be sealed as well.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
科斯海和我被魔法绑定在一起。如果一方的力量被封印，另一方也必须被封印。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
But the original seal weakened over time and Koshei was able to get out of his confinement. That is why I asked you to get me out of here.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
但最初的封印随着时间推移而减弱，科斯海得以逃脱束缚。这就是为什么我让你把我救出来。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
He realized that I was trying to break free and waited here for anyone who would help me. I never ever expected it...
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
他意识到我想挣脱束缚，便在这里等待任何会帮助我的人。我从未想到过这一点...

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Anyway, I'm so grateful for everything you did.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
总之，我非常感激你所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
Please accept my poor reward, I hope that it will be of some help for such a brave adventurer. I hope that the gods will bless you on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
请收下我微薄的奖励，希望这对勇敢的冒险者有所帮助。愿众神保佑你的旅途。

scripts.text:
[Maria Morebna]
It's been a long time since I've felt the sunlight, fresh wind and the scent of grass. I'm so grateful.
scripts.translation:
[玛丽亚·莫雷布娜]
我已经很久没有感受到阳光、清新的微风和草地的芬芳了。我非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
... Koshei is immortal and will surely appear again someday...
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
...科斯海是不死的，总有一天他一定会再次出现...

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
When that time comes, I will deal with him. I will use my time of waiting to train to make myself strong whenever he returns...
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
当那一天来临时，我会亲自解决他。我会利用等待的时间磨练自己，变得更强，无论他何时归来...

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
I'm grateful that you did your best for me and my village. I will never forget your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
我很感激你为了我和村庄竭尽全力。我永远不会忘记你的善意。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Ah, Go to Baba Yaga in your free time. She seems to have something to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
啊，有空的时候去找找芭芭雅嘎吧。她似乎有话要告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Girl's Voice]
Take care of yourself. It is better for you to stay away from here because, Koshei may try to use your power as his own, huhu.
scripts.translation:
[女孩的声音]
请保重。最好离这里远一点，因为科斯海可能会试图利用你的力量为己用，呼呼。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Why are you carrying that much?
Are you training for something?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
你为什么要带这么多东西？
是在为某件事做准备吗？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~
Good weather! Eh?
Perfect for a picnic.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
巴哈哈~
天气真好！咦？
正是野餐的好天气。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
But, I've heard that some people have become lost in the forest on the island near this village. What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
不过，我听说有些人在这座村庄附近岛屿的森林里迷路了。这是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~
Good weather! Eh?
Perfect for a picnic.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
巴哈哈~
天气真好！咦？
正是野餐的好天气。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
But, I've heard that some people have become lost in the forest on the island near this village. What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
不过，我听说有些人在这座村庄附近岛屿的森林里迷路了。这是怎么回事？

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打扰一下...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, have you heard of a keymaker who knows how to make a '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，你听说过会制作'^0000ff黄金色钥匙^000000'的钥匙匠吗？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Hmm, are you an adventurer? Who told you about the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
嗯，你是冒险者吗？是谁告诉你'^0000ff黄金色钥匙^000000'的事的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, in fact...

- You tell him about -
- Maria Morebna -
- and Gray Wolf -
scripts.translation:
- 告诉他关于 -
- 玛丽亚·莫雷布娜 -
- 和灰狼的事 -

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Well, then... The keymaker for the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'.
You are very lucky to have asked me about this.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
那么...关于'^0000ff黄金色钥匙^000000'的钥匙匠。
你能问到我，真是运气好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W, what do you mean...?

[The Blacksmith]
I'm the only one in this town that knows what materials are needed to make the '^0000ffGolden Key^000000'! Bahaha!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
我是这个镇上唯一知道制作'^0000ff黄金色钥匙^000000'需要哪些材料的人！巴哈哈！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
I guess you think that getting the materials will be easy huh?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
我想你大概觉得收集材料很容易吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey I didn't say...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，我可没这么说...

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahahaha~
It will take a lot of work.
A long journey awaits you
If you choose to take it.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
巴哈哈哈~
这需要付出很多努力。
如果你选择接受，
前方将是一段漫长的旅程。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Your boots will be worn
out after this journey.
What do you think?
Would you like to try?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
你的靴子会在旅途中磨破。
你觉得怎么样？
想试试吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course! I have to help Maria!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然！我必须帮助玛丽亚！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha! I like you!
Ok, first, bring me ^0000ff25 Steel^000000. I'm not going anywhere so come back here when you have them.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
巴哈哈！我喜欢你！
好，首先，给我带^0000ff25个钢铁^000000来。我就在这里，拿到后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok so that's the first thing you need for the 'Golden Key' right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，所以这是制作“黄金色钥匙”需要的第一个材料，对吧？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahahaha~
I promise you, I'll explain when you bring the ^0000ff25 Steel^000000 to me. Please just get the Steel and come back.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
巴哈哈哈~
我向你保证，等你把^0000ff25个钢铁^000000带给我时，我会解释的。请先把钢铁找来再回来。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ohhh, that was faster than I expected!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
哦，比我预想的还要快！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ok then, wait here.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
那么，在这里等一下。

scripts.text:
- He melts the steel -
- and begins to forge -
- it into something !! -
scripts.translation:
- 他熔化了钢铁 -
- 并开始锻造 -
- 成某种东西！！ -

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~, it's not my
best work, but it'll do.
Here ya go!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
巴哈哈~，虽然不是我的得意之作，但够用了。
给你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah?! This is?!!

[The Blacksmith]
Strong Steel Boots!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
强力钢铁靴！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~ Didn't I tell you? A long journey awaits you. These boots will help you on your long journey.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
巴哈哈~ 我没告诉过你吗？前方将是一段漫长的旅程。这双靴子会在旅途中帮到你。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
When they have worn out, you will know that your journey is near it's end.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
当它们磨破时，你就知道旅程即将结束了。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
^ff0000You must always wear these boots while gathering the materials for the 'Golden Key'.^000000
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
^ff0000在收集制作“黄金色钥匙”的材料时，你必须一直穿着这双靴子。^000000

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ok, I'll tell you what materials you need to get. I can make the key anytime if you get them to me.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
好，我会告诉你需要哪些材料。只要你把它们带给我，我随时可以打造钥匙。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
You need ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000 to make the key.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
制作钥匙需要^0000ff2 1个诅咒红宝石、3个黄金、1个红戒指、2束盧莎卡的头发、10根金线^000000。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Well, you know what to do now. I will be waiting here.
Bahahaha~
And don't forget to wear these!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
好了，你知道该做什么了。我会在这里等你。
巴哈哈哈~
别忘了穿上这双靴子！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
What are you doing? First, you must get me ^0000ff25 Steel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
你在做什么？首先，你必须给我带^0000ff25个钢铁^000000来。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The faster you get me the materials, The faster you can help Maria Morebna.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
你越快给我材料，就能越快帮助玛丽亚·莫雷布娜。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什么...？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
So, you got all the materials. I can't believe it.
You did your best until your boots were worn out, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
所以，你集齐了所有材料。真不敢相信。
你一直努力到靴子磨破为止，对吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, you know, it's not very comfortable walking around in Steel boots all day!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，你知道的，整天穿着钢铁靴子走路并不舒服！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bahaha~ Ok, well done.
Well.. While you were looking for the materials, I was searching for the keymaker who can make the key!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
巴哈哈~ 好，干得不错。
嗯... 在你寻找材料的时候，我也在寻找能打造这把钥匙的钥匙匠！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I thought you said that you knew how to make the key?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不是说你知道怎么打造这把钥匙吗？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Hmm... Well I know the materials. And I know who makes the key. So I will tell you where to find the keymaker. Is that ok?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
嗯... 好吧，我知道材料。我也知道谁打造这把钥匙。所以我会告诉你去哪里找钥匙匠。这样可以吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course! I have to know where this person is.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然！我必须知道这个人在哪里。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ok, listen carefully. The Keymaker is at a cabin deep inside of the forest.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
好，仔细听。钥匙匠在普勒斯特森林深处的一个小屋里。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ah, wait. Take off your armor. I need to cast a protection spell on you, ok? Hey, don't get the wrong idea. This is just a simple protection spell!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
啊，等等。脱下你的盔甲。我需要给你施加一个保护咒语，好吗？嘿，别想歪了。这只是一个简单的保护咒语！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Bah ram y--- wait that's uh something else...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
巴...拉姆... 等等，这...这是另一回事...

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
'^ff0000Spellshield Protection^000000.

[The Blacksmith]
This spell protects you from any curse the keymaker might try to use. Remember the words of the spell. It won't last very long because I am just a blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
这个咒语可以保护你免受钥匙匠可能使用的任何诅咒。记住咒语的内容。它不会持续太久，因为我只是个铁匠。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The forest is dangerous. Be very careful in there!
Ah, and your steel boots..?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
森林很危险。在里面一定要非常小心！
啊，还有你的钢铁靴子...

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The forest is dangerous. Be very careful in there!
Ah and you shouldn't be needing those Steel Boots anymore. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
森林很危险。在里面一定要非常小心！
啊，而且你不再需要那些钢铁靴子了。祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Where are they?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
它们在哪里？

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
You need ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000 to make the key.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
制作钥匙需要^0000ff2 1个诅咒红宝石、3个黄金、1个红戒指、2束盧莎卡的头发、10根金线^000000。

scripts.text: Red Ring?
scripts.translation: 红戒指

scripts.text: Lusalka's Hair?
scripts.translation: 卢萨尔卡的头发

scripts.text: Golden Thread?
scripts.translation: 金线

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The Red Ring has powerful enchanting powers. I had one before, but I gave it to my friend, Vassili, as a gift.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
红戒指拥有强大的附魔力量。我以前有一个，但我把它作为礼物送给了我的朋友瓦西里。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
I think it would be odd to ask him to give it back to me. So uh you've got to ask him if he would give it to you.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
我觉得让他把它还给我有点奇怪。所以呃，你得问问他是否愿意把它给你。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
It's said that a bride who drowns to death just before her wedding becomes Lusalka, the aqua fairy.
You must find Lusalka's hair.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
据说在婚礼前溺水而死的未婚妻会变成卢萨尔卡，水之妖精。
你必须找到卢萨尔卡的头发。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
I heard that a young maid has been lost recently.
It's very unfortunate but...
she might be Lusalka...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
我听说最近有个年轻的女仆失踪了。
这很不幸，但是...
她可能就是卢萨尔卡...

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Her mother is somewhere in this village asking for people to help her find her missing daughter.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
她的母亲在这个村庄的某个地方，正在请求人们帮她寻找失踪的女儿。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Golden Thread is made from gold by using a special spinning wheel technique. I don't know exactly how it's done. But I know who does.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
金线是用特殊的纺纱技术从黄金中制成的。我不太清楚具体怎么做。但我知道谁懂。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Find a man named Marozka. He is the only one who knows how to use the spinning wheel to make the Golden Thread.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
去找一个叫马罗兹卡的男子。他是唯一知道如何用纺纱机制作金线的人。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Maria should know where he is.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
玛丽亚应该知道他在哪里。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ah, and... You still have the boots that I made right? ^ff0000Without them, you cannot get anything for the key, I swear. You must put on them.^000000
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
啊，对了...你身上还穿着我做的靴子吧？^ff0000没有它们，你绝对拿不到钥匙，我发誓。你必须穿上它们。^000000

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Well, you know what to do now. I will be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
好了，你知道该怎么做。我会在这里等你。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The keymaker is at a cabin deep inside of the forest.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
钥匙匠人在森林深处的一个小屋。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
This person is no ordinary person. It is said that you can be cursed by the keymaker's words.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
这个人不是普通人。据说你会被钥匙匠人的话语诅咒。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Don't forget the spell, '^ff0000Spellshield Protection.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
别忘了咒语，'^ff0000魔法盾。^000000'

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
He is in his cabin deep inside of the forest. There, the keymaker of the Golden Key is living.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
他在森林深处的小屋里。那里住着黄金色钥匙的钥匙匠人。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
The Golden Key is able to release Maria. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
黄金色钥匙可以释放玛丽亚。祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
I heard the news. You have done well.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
我听到消息了。你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[The Blacksmith]
Ah, the person living around that cabin wants you to see her. She seems to have something to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
啊，住在那附近小屋的人想见你。她似乎有话要告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Why are you carring that much?
Are you training for something?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
你为什么背了这么多东西？
是在训练什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Hmm, are you an adventurer? So, how do you like it here?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
嗯，你是冒险者吗？那么，你觉得这里怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's not too bad.
The weather here is great!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还不错。
这里的天气很棒！

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Even though it is fine now in Moscovia, it is not such a great place during the harsh winter season.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
虽然莫斯科比亚现在很美好，但在寒冷的冬季，这里并不是个很好的地方。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Eeee, I don't want to experience that coldness any more.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
唉，我再也不想经历那种寒冷了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什么...？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Hmm, are you an adventurer? So, how do you like it here?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
嗯，你是冒险者吗？那么，你觉得这里怎么样？

scripts.text: It's so-so
scripts.translation: 一般般

scripts.text: I have something to ask...
scripts.translation: 我有事想问...

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Hmm, you have traveled so much. I guess if you're tired from your trip then it's only natural, huhu.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
嗯，你走了很多路。我想如果你旅途劳累，那也是很自然的，呼呼。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Eh? What do you want to ask me about?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
咦？你想问我什么？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Red Ring?! Why are you looking for that?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
红戒指？！你为什么要找那个？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Mmm, what? I don't understand you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
嗯？什么？我不明白你的意思。

scripts.text:
- You tell him about the -
- Gray Wolf and Maria -
scripts.translation:
- 你告诉他关于 -
- 灰狼和玛丽亚的事 -

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Huuuh, I see.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
呼...原来如此。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
What should I do?
I want to help but I can't.
I gave it to my youngest
daughter, Mashenka,
as a present. But... she...
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
我该怎么办？
我想帮忙，但我无能为力。
我把它作为礼物送给了我的小女儿，玛申卡。但是...她...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
It's just that Mashenka...
..........
....she died...

[Vassili Grandpapa]
She was really pretty and smart. My first daughter, Ryubaba, is also pretty and smart but her temper is...
hotter than Ifrit's flames!
Do you know what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
她非常漂亮，也很聪明。我的大女儿，柳芭芭，也很漂亮聪明，但她的脾气...
比伊夫利特的火焰还要火爆！
你明白我的意思吗？

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
Anyway, Mashenka was such a kind and tender daughter. On cold winter nights, when I came back home late, she would wait for me with a hot bowl of my favorite stew.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
总之，玛申卡是个非常温柔体贴的女儿。在寒冷的冬夜，当我深夜回家时，她总会为我留着一碗热腾腾的我最爱喝的汤。

scripts.text:
[Vassili Grandpapa]
How couldn't I be touched by such kindness? So, I gave the Red Ring to her as a gift.
I can still remember how happy she was when I gave it to her.
scripts.translation:
[瓦西里爷爷]
面对这样的善意，我怎能不感动？所以，我把红戒指作为礼物送给了她。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm from Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来自卢恩·米德加兹。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
...Rune... Midgarts...
A few days ago, my lover left for Rune-Midgarts.. Can you find him for me? I want to talk with him...
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
...卢恩...米德加兹...
几天前，我的爱人去了卢恩·米德加兹。你能帮我找到他吗？我想和他谈谈...

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
...I don't know why but, I can't remember how I became Lusalka. When I woke up, I was lying down on the bottom of the river.
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
...我不知道为什么，但我记不起我是怎么变成卢萨尔卡的。当我醒来时，我正躺在河底。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I forgot everything, but not him. His smile and warm hand. I remember everything about him.
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
我忘记了一切，除了他。他的笑容和温暖的手。关于他的一切我都记得。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I watched him from the bottom of the river sitting randomly around the river and staring into the marsh. With very sad eyes.
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
我从河底看着他，随意地坐在河边，凝视着沼泽。他的眼神非常悲伤。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I suffered seeing him grieve, but wasn't able to meet him. Ordinary people are killed immediately when they see Lusalka's stare...
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
看着他悲伤让我很痛苦，但我无法与他相见。普通人看到卢萨尔卡的凝视会立刻死去...

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I saw him coming to the marsh everyday and heard him mourning. And his assurance to go to Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
我看到他每天都来到沼泽，听到他哀悼。还有他要去卢恩·米德加兹的决心。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Adventurer, can you find him for me? I can't leave this marsh. Please, find him for me?
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
冒险者，你能帮我找到他吗？我无法离开这片沼泽。求你了，帮我找到他？

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I don't want him to come back or to meet me again. But, Please tell him that I hope he'll stop suffering and to be happy.
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
我不希望他回来，也不希望再见到我。但是，请告诉他，我希望他停止痛苦，幸福地生活。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
I became Lusalka, but it is ok. I'm not sad. But, I can feel his sadness around this river that surrounds me. I feel sorry about it.
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
我变成了卢萨尔卡，但这没关系。我不悲伤。但我能感觉到围绕着我的这条河流中，他的悲伤。这让我感到难过。

scripts.text:
[Lusalka]
Please, find him and tell him that I am ok and to stop suffering...
scripts.translation:
[卢萨尔卡]
请找到他，告诉他我很好，让他停止痛苦...

[{0}]

[{0}]
I brought a message from her. She says not to suffer anymore and to just be happy...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我带来了她的信。她说不要再受苦了，只要快乐就好...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The more you suffer, the deeper she sinks into sadness. Don't think that you're the only one that's suffering...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你越痛苦，她就陷得越深。别以为只有你一个人在受苦...

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
...Svetlana?!
Wait, how could you...? She... how do I know that she really spoke to you?!
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
...斯维特兰娜？！
等等，你怎么会...？她...我怎么知道她真的跟你说过话？！

scripts.text:
-^0000ff Without a word, ^000000-
-^0000ff you give him Lusalka's ^000000-
-^0000ff golden earrings ^000000-

[A gloomy looking soldier]
T, this is Svetlana's...?!
H, how did you!?
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
这...这是斯维特兰娜的...？！
你...你怎么会有这个？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I met her by accident. She became Lusalka in the marsh of Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我偶然遇见了她。她在莫斯科比亚的沼泽里变成了卢萨尔卡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She told me that you wouldn't believe me so she gave me these earrings as proof... The present that you gave to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她说你不会相信我，所以给了我这对耳环作为证明...那是你送给她的礼物。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Is that true?
Did she really become Lusalka?
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
这是真的吗？
她真的变成了卢萨尔卡？

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
It was near the end of the harsh Moscovia winter... She... didn't realize that the ice on the marsh was already melting...
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
那是莫斯科比亚严冬的末尾...她...没有意识到沼泽上的冰已经开始融化了...

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
By then, it was too late the ice cracked where she was and she fell into the freezing cold marsh.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
等到发现时已经太迟了，她脚下的冰裂开了，她掉进了冰冷刺骨的沼泽里。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
She wasn't able to swim. I tried to get her out but it was impossible.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
她不会游泳。我试图把她拉上来，但根本做不到。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
She sunk quickly into the marsh. I was able to reach her hand but, she realized that it would kill both of us and she released my hand... I regret that moment every single day.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
她迅速沉入了沼泽。我抓住了她的手，但她意识到这样会害死我们两个人，于是松开了手...我每天都在为那一刻感到后悔。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
My last memory of her was of her smiling, as she sunk into the cold, wet marsh. As if to say, 'You will be ok.'
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
我对她最后的记忆，是她微笑着沉入冰冷潮湿的沼泽。仿佛在说：'你会没事的。'

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
I, I was a coward. I was too afraid of drowning to pull her out of the marsh. Too afraid of....
Oh... Svetlana!!!
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
我...我是个懦夫。我太害怕溺水了，不敢把她从沼泽里拉上来。太害怕...了...
噢...斯维特兰娜！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什么...？

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
I knew that she had become the cursed nymph Lusalka. But, I still went every night... to find her. I just wanted to see her and talk to her.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
我知道她变成了被诅咒的精灵卢萨尔卡。但我还是每晚都去...寻找她。我只是想看看她，和她说话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She told me that she also wanted to see you. But, she was afraid that Lusalka's curse would kill you if you saw her.
And so she hid...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她说她也想见你。但她害怕卢萨尔卡的诅咒会在你看到她时夺走你的性命。
所以她躲起来了...

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
How could she think of me...
...I, how should I.. Should I...
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
她怎么能这样想我...
...我，我该怎么办...我应该...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't be sad. She still loves you. Your suffering is her suffering.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
别难过。她依然爱着你。你的痛苦就是她的痛苦。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
................................................She is? Thank you. You've encouraged me.

[A gloomy looking soldier]
I will go back to Moscovia. But, I'm not well enough at the moment to go back.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
我会回到莫斯科比亚的。但我现在的状态还不够好，无法立刻回去。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Could you please go to her and tell her my message?
I remember every moment I've had with her and... I still love her.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
请你去见她，把我的话告诉她好吗？
我记得和她在一起的每一个瞬间...我依然爱着她。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Before the full moon, I will be back to Moscovia and meet her. I will come back so strong and happy that when I go to see her she will not suffer anymore.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
在满月之前，我会回到莫斯科比亚见她。我会变得足够强大和快乐，这样当我去见她时，她就不会再受苦了。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Could you please go to her and tell her my message?
I remember every moment I've had with her and... I still love her.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
请你去见她，把我的话告诉她好吗？
我记得和她在一起的每一个瞬间...我依然爱着她。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
Before the full moon, I will be back to Moscovia and meet her. I will come back so strong and happy that when I go to see her she will not suffer anymore.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
在满月之前，我会回到莫斯科比亚见她。我会变得足够强大和快乐，这样当我去见她时，她就不会再受苦了。

scripts.text:
[A gloomy looking soldier]
... I feel like I lost something precious.
scripts.translation:
[神情阴郁的士兵]
...我感觉自己失去了什么珍贵的东西。

scripts.text: - He looks down at the golden earrings and rubs it carefully -
scripts.translation: - 他低头看着那对镀金项链，小心翼翼地擦拭着 -

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
Who dares to come into my cave!
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的声音]
谁敢闯进我的洞穴！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Marozka? Maria sent me! I need your 'Golden Thread' to make a 'Golden Key' to release her from the wall!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是马罗兹卡吗？是玛丽亚派我来的！我需要你的“金线”来制作“黄金色钥匙”，以释放被<黑暗搜集者>墙困住的她！

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
...To make a 'Golden Key'?
Do you think that you are right for this job?
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的声音]
...制作“黄金色钥匙”？
你以为自己适合做这件事吗？

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
You must be fighting against 'Koshei' if you are asking about the 'Golden Key' and Maria! Do you think that you are strong enough to fight against him?
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的声音]
既然你在打听“黄金色钥匙”和玛丽亚，那你一定是在对抗“科谢伊”！你以为自己有足够的实力与他战斗吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course I'm strong enough!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我当然有足够的实力！

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
You are very confident.
But, I need to test you to see if you truly are capable.
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的声音]
你很有自信。
但我需要测试你，看看你是否真的有能力。

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
In this cave, there is a 'Stone Furnace' and an 'Apple Tree'.
You can escape from the cave with ^0000ff100 Well Baked Cookies^000000 from the Stone Furnace and ^0000ff100 Apples^000000 from the Apple Tree.
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的声音]
在这个洞穴里，有一个“石炉”和一棵“苹果树”。
你可以用石炉里的^0000ff100烤好的饼干^000000和苹果树上的^0000ff100苹果^000000离开洞穴。

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
It won't be easy. Monsters are wandering around the Stone Furnace and the Apple Tree.
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的声音]
这不会容易。魔物在石炉和苹果树周围游荡。

scripts.text:
[Voice unidentified]
Show me what you can do.
scripts.translation:
[身份不明的声音]
让我看看你的本事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什么...？

scripts.text:
- You can see the -
- well baked cookies. -
- Be careful and -
- don't get burned -
scripts.translation:
- 你可以看到 -
- 烤好的饼干。 -
- 小心一点， -
- 别被烫到 -

scripts.text:
- You quickly stretch out -
- your hand and pick up -
- the well baked cookies! -
scripts.translation:
- 你迅速伸出手 -
- 拿起了烤好的饼干！ -

scripts.text:
- ^0000ffYou got 100^000000 -
- ^0000ffWell Baked Cookies!!^000000 -

- You quickly stretch out -
- your hand and pick up -
- the well baked cookies! -
scripts.translation:
- 你迅速伸出手 -
- 拿起了烤好的饼干！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oops, it's hot, hot!!!

[Marozka's Guard]
How did this rat get inside the cave?!
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡的卫兵]
这只老鼠是怎么钻进洞穴里的？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什么...？

scripts.text:
- There are Ripe Apples -
- growing in clusters. -
- But they are higher than -
- you expected them to be -
scripts.translation:
- 结实的苹果 -
- 成串地生长着。 -
- 但它们比你 -
- 预想的要高 -

scripts.text:
- You hit the tree firmly, -
- and the apples fall down! -
scripts.translation:
- 你用力敲打树干， -
- 苹果掉了下来！ -

scripts.text:
- You hit the tree firmly, -
- worms fall down! -
scripts.translation:
- 你用力敲打树干， -
- 虫子掉了下来！ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ahhhhhhhh!!!
- ^0000ff You get 100 Apples !!^000000 -

[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什么...？

[马罗兹卡]
...你来了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Marozka? Here, I've proven to you my strength now can you make me the 'Golden Thread'?
I need it to get Maria out of that wall.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是马罗兹卡吗？我已经向你证明了我的实力，现在你能给我制作“金线”吗？
我需要它来把玛丽亚从墙里救出来。

scripts.text:
- You put the cookies and -
- apples in front of him -
- and he slowly utters -
scripts.translation:
- 你把饼干和 -
- 苹果放在他面前 -
- 他缓缓说道 -

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
As you've heard, to make the 'Golden Thread' is very difficult and takes a very long time.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
正如你所知，制作“金线”非常困难，而且需要很长的时间。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I will begin making it now... let me see... Could you please come back to me in an hour?
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
我现在就开始制作...让我看看...你能在一小时后回来找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Ah, just in time.
I have finally finished making the 'Golden Thread'. Just wait one more second and it'll be ready.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
啊，正好赶上。
我终于完成了“金线”的制作。再等一秒，它就准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
As you've heard, to make the 'Golden Thread' is very difficult and takes a very long time.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
正如你所知，制作“金线”非常困难，而且需要很长的时间。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I will begin making it now... let me see... Could you please come back to me in an hour?
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
我现在就开始制作...让我看看...你能在一小时后回来找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
As promised, here's the 'Golden Thread'.
So, you are really going to fight Koshei the Immportal, eh?
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
如约而至，这是“金线”。
所以，你真的要去挑战不死者科斯希吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know but I promised to get Maria out of there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道，但我答应过要把玛丽亚从那里救出来。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Huh, Koshei is not your average adversary. Strength alone cannot beat him. You will need wisdom and an unfaltering spirit in order to win.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
科斯希可不是普通的对手。仅凭力量是无法战胜他的。你需要智慧和坚定的意志才能获胜。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Koshei will be extremely hostile to you because you are helping Maria.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
因为你帮助了玛丽亚，科斯希会对你极度敌视。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Do you still want the Golden Thread? Ok, I will give it to you! But, there is one more test.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
你还要金线吗？好吧，我会给你的！但是，还有一个考验。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
One more test?
Didn't I already prove my worth?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还有一个考验？
我不是已经证明了自己的价值吗？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
That was a test of your strength. Now you must pass the test of mind and wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
那是对你力量的考验。现在，你必须通过智慧和心智的考验。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Hmm, did I forget to wear something...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...嗯，我是不是忘了穿什么...？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
...So? Have you decided?
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
...那么？你决定了吗？

scripts.text: I need more time...
scripts.translation: 我需要更多时间...

scripts.text: I will take it!
scripts.translation: 我接受！

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Ok then. Come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
好吧。等你准备好了再回来。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
You will... Ok, let's get to it. You must answer all of these questions correctly in order to pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
你会...好吧，让我们开始吧。你必须正确回答所有这些问题才能通过考验。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
What is deaf, dumb, and blind and always tells the truth?
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
什么东西是聋的、哑的、瞎的，却总是说真话？

scripts.text: A Poring
scripts.translation: 波利

scripts.text: A Picky
scripts.translation: 小鸡

scripts.text: A Mirror
scripts.translation: 镜子

scripts.text: A Tree
scripts.translation: 树

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
If 4 cats can catch 4 mice every 4 minutes, what is the minimum number of cats needed to get 10 mice in 10 minutes?
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
如果4只猫每4分钟能抓4只老鼠，那么要在10分钟内抓10只老鼠，最少需要几只猫？

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Which of these gets shorter during winter and longer during summer?
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
下列哪样东西在冬天会变短，在夏天会变长？

scripts.text: Sky
scripts.translation: 天空

scripts.text: Day
scripts.translation: 白天

scripts.text: Waves
scripts.translation: 波浪

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 风

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Doris Etticoat, wears a petticoat and has a red nose; the longer she stands, the shorter she grows. What is she?
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
多丽丝·艾提科特，穿着衬裙，有着红色的鼻子；她站得越久，身体就越短。她是什么？

scripts.text: A Star
scripts.translation: 星星

scripts.text: A Candle
scripts.translation: 蜡烛

scripts.text: A Sword
scripts.translation: 剑

scripts.text: The Moon
scripts.translation: 月亮

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
My top and bottom are twins of a kind. The middle of me makes one body combined. If I stand tall and still, run faster I will. What am I?
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
我的头和脚是某种意义上的双胞胎。我的中间部分将两者结合成一个整体。如果我站得笔直静止，我跑得就会更快。我是什么？

scripts.text: A Woman
scripts.translation: 女子

scripts.text: Valkyrie
scripts.translation: 瓦尔基里

scripts.text: The Moon
scripts.translation: 月亮

scripts.text: An Hourglass
scripts.translation: 沙漏

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
Now let's see how you did.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
现在来看看你的表现吧。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
You got all of them correct.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
你全部答对了。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I told you before that I wouldn't give you the Golden Thread until you got all questions correct.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
我之前说过，除非你答对所有问题，否则我不会把金线给你。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
It is not too late to try again. With wisdom comes patience.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
现在再试一次也不晚。智慧伴随着耐心。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I know that a quiz is a strange way of evaluating a person's wisdom. But, it is my way of knowing if you are truly committed to fighting Koshei.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
我知道用问答来评判一个人的智慧有些奇怪。但这是我确认你是否真的下定决心要对抗科斯希的方式。

scripts.text:
[Marozka]
I hope you help Maria with your strength and kindness.
scripts.translation:
[马罗兹卡]
希望你能用你的力量和善良去帮助玛丽亚。

scripts.text:
- He closes his eyes -
- and stands still -
scripts.translation:
- 他闭上了眼睛 -
- 静静地站着 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
...........................
If you lotter around here any longer, I will make myself some tasty human soup! Hehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
...........................
你们要是再在这里闲逛，我就把自己煮成一锅美味的人肉汤！嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Why are you here, you yummy looking human? If you lotter around here any longer, I will make myself some tasty human soup! Hehehehehe
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你们这些看起来很好吃的人类，为什么在这里？要是再在这里闲逛，我就把自己煮成一锅美味的人肉汤！嘿嘿嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I, ah, I.. Gold.. golden...

[Baba Yaga]
What are you babbling about?
Do you want me to transform you into a savage beast?!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你在胡说什么？
要不要我把你变成一只野兽？！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
'Presto Change-o!!'
'Turn into a pig!!'
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
“变变变！！”
“变成猪！！”

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Hmm? You are protected by a Protection Spell?
But, it was weake. My spell destroyed it.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
嗯？你被保护咒语保护着？
但是，它很弱。我的咒语摧毁了它。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Leave now, or I will curse you again! 'Presto...'
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
现在离开，否则我会再次诅咒你！“变变变...”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...

[{0}]
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
{1} !!!

[{0}]
Eh, eh.. I mean.. I say.. spell...
{1} !!!

[Baba Yaga]
What are you planning to do with that weak spell!?
Get away, child!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你打算用那个弱小的咒语做什么？！
快滚，小孩！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ho, you are protected by a Protection Spell. You are no ordinary kid.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
哦，你被保护咒语保护着。你不是普通的小孩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that you are able to make the 'Golden Key' and that's why I am here!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说你能制作“黄金色钥匙”，所以我才来到这里！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
'Golden Key'? Why do you need it?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
“黄金色钥匙”？你为什么要它？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need it to release Maria Mobrena from her dark wall prison.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要它来释放玛丽亚·莫雷布娜，把她从黑暗之墙中解救出来。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
...Maria Morebna...
Are you fighting against Koshei?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
...玛丽亚·莫雷布娜...
你是在对抗科斯希吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If he gets in my way of keeping my promise to her, I guess that I will fight him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果他阻碍我履行对她的承诺，我想我会和他战斗。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ho, kiheeheheheheheh. Ehehehehehehe.
You are interesting. You don't seem to be scared of Koshei.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
呵呵，嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
你很有趣。你似乎并不害怕科斯希。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok, the materials for the key are...
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好吧，制作钥匙的材料是...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You have already gatered all the materials?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你已经收集齐所有材料了吗？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
What? I cannot make you the 'Golden Key' without the materials.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
什么？没有材料，我无法为你制作“黄金色钥匙”。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Go and find ^0000ff2 Cursed Ruby, 3 Gold, 1 Red Ring, 2 Lusalka's Hair, 10 Golden Thread^000000!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
去收集^0000ff2 诅咒红宝石、3个金币、1个红戒指、2份盧莎卡的头发、10根金线^000000！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok, let's begin. Ah, before that... Wait here!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好吧，让我们开始吧。啊，在那之前...站在这里别动！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You come here!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你过来！

scripts.text:
- Baba Yaga looks -
- at you carefully -
scripts.translation:
- 芭芭雅嘎 -
- 仔细地打量着你 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Hmmm, you look energetic and strong. Ok, while I make the 'Golden Key', you must first do a favor for me!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
嗯，你看起来精力充沛且强壮。好吧，在我制作“黄金色钥匙”的时候，你必须先帮我一个忙！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
My cow has run away. Find her and cast a Return Spell on her. The spell is '^ff0000Good feed is orange-flavored^000000'. You sould remember it.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
我的奶牛跑掉了。找到她并对她施放“返回”法术。法术是'^ff0000好吃的饲料是橙色的^000000'。你应该记得它。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok! Move, move! You better be quick or I will find a way to punish you. Ehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好！快走，快走！你最好快点，否则我会想办法惩罚你的。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Behind my house, there is noisy coffin. It has been so nosiy recently that I can't sleep. Silence it.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
在我房子后面，有一个吵闹的棺材。最近它太吵了，让我无法入睡。让它安静下来。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok! Move, move! You better be quick or I will find a way to punish you. Ehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好！快走，快走！你最好快点，否则我会想办法惩罚你的。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Please find my silver spoons. Those bad pirates stole them. I can feel them around the wrecked ship. Bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
请找到我的银勺子。那些坏海盗偷走了它们。我能感觉到它们在沉船附近。把它们带给我。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok! Move, move! You better be quick or I will find a way to punish you. Ehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好！快走，快走！你最好快点，否则我会想办法惩罚你的。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Buy me a magic book. It is published by Momotaro in Amatsu. Go there and buy it for me.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
帮我买一本魔法书。它是樱花城的桃太郎出版的。去那里帮我买回来。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

你能看到小屋旁边的罐子吗？里面住着一个屋中幽灵。把它赶出去。它让我很烦躁。

Ho, did you buy the magic book? Give it to me. I will try it out.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
嘿，你买到魔法书了吗？给我。我要试试。

scripts.text:
- Baba Yaga takes the book, -
reads one of the pages, -
and casts something -
scripts.translation:
- 芭芭雅嘎接过书， -
读了一页， -
然后施放了什么 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Ok.. Let's do this.
'Keep off the grass!!!'
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
好...让我们开始吧。
“禁止践踏草坪！！！”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W, what is this, suddenly?!

[Baba Yaga]
Ho.. this is for a beautiful garden. This is better than I expected. Ok then, let's do this.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
呵...这是为了美丽的花园。这比我预期的要好。那么，让我们开始吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, are you listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，你在听我说话吗？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
'There is an order for you to open your eyes!!!'
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
“命令你睁开眼睛！！！”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are you doing!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在干什么！！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Hmm, this one makes people deligent and doesn't look effective. Ok then, next is a House Ghost...
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
嗯，这个让人变得勤勉，看起来没什么效果。那么，下一个是屋中幽灵...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, I am talking...

[Baba Yaga]
'In the corner...'
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
“在角落里...”

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
What, child? Do you feel bad?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
怎么了，孩子？你感觉不舒服吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When will you give me the key?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你什么时候给我钥匙？！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Huh, I can make it for you right now. You have a violent temper.
scripts.translation:

哈，我现在就可以为你制作。你的脾气真暴躁。

I have done your favor! I got the cow!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我帮你办好了！我抓住了奶牛！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Oh, great. I just finished making the 'Golden Key'!
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
哦，太好了。我刚做好“黄金色钥匙”！

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Here, help Maria with this key and watch out for Koshei. He is very dangerous. Kehehehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
拿着，帮玛丽亚用这把钥匙，小心科斯赫。他非常危险。嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:

[{0}]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You got the key and went to Maria immedately, right?
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你拿到钥匙后，立刻去找玛丽亚了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Take care of yourself. When you release her, Koshei will come out and bring destruction.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
照顾好你自己。当你释放她时，科斯赫就会出来，带来毁灭。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
What are you doing here? Kehehehe.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你在这里做什么？嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Koshei... suddenly appeared.. and Maria.. Wolf... killed...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
科斯赫...突然出现了...然后玛丽亚...狼...杀死了...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Calm down and speak slowly. I cannot hear you at all. Drink some water.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
冷静点，慢慢说。我完全听不清你在说什么。喝点水吧。

scripts.text:
- You drink some water and -
- tell her the story slowly -
scripts.translation:
- 你喝了一些水 -
- 慢慢地把故事告诉她 -

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
You beat Koshei? Did you?
Kehehe, you are no ordinary kid.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
你打败了科斯赫？真的吗？
嘿嘿，你可不是普通的小孩。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
Water to enliven Maria...
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
让玛丽亚复活的水...

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]
'Living Water'... I just need the ingredients.  I need ^0000ff1 Holy Water^000000 and ^0000ff2 Yggdrasil Leaves^000000.
scripts.translation:
[芭芭雅嘎]
“生命之水”...我只需要材料。我需要^0000ff1圣水^000000和^0000ff2世界树叶子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Baba Yaga]

scripts.translation:
