scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
No! Please stop it! I was wrong!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
不！请停下！我错了！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
I have been bored. After dying, I've had nothing to do and no friends to play with..
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
我真的很无聊。死后，我无事可做，也没有朋友可以一起玩...

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
When I was alive, I always stayed still, but now it's too boring...
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
活着的时候，我总是待在原地，但现在实在太无聊了...

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
I can't even drink my favorite milk... Being a ghost is too inconvenient.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
我甚至喝不了我最喜欢的牛奶...当幽灵真是太不方便了。

scripts.text: Can I play with you?
scripts.translation: 我可以和你一起玩吗？

scripts.text: So what can I do for you?
scripts.translation: 那我该为你做些什么呢？

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ehhh, are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
呃...你确定吗？

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Hmm, can you do something for me? It won't take much time.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
嗯，你能帮我做点事吗？不会花太多时间的。

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
What about a card game? I was good at those games! Ah, where are my cards? Wait here! I'll find them!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
玩纸牌游戏怎么样？我很擅长这些游戏！啊，我的牌在哪里？等一下！我去找找！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Hehe, what about a card game? I have an Angeling, Ghostring and a Poring Card.
All you have to do is just guess which card I pick up!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
嘿嘿，玩纸牌游戏怎么样？我有一张天使波利卡片、一张幽灵波利卡片和一张波利卡片。
你只需要猜我拿起的是哪一张！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Let's play best out of 5. So if you win 3 games, I promise to stay quiet!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
我们玩五局三胜吧。如果你赢了3局，我保证保持安静！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok! It will be fun. Let's do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好！听起来很有趣。我们开始吧。

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ok, first let me shuffle these cards around.
Ready!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
好，先让我把这些牌洗一洗。
准备好了！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
One!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
一！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
One! Two!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
一！二！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
One! Two! Three!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
一！二！三！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ok! I will pick one of them up!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
好！我要拿起其中一张了！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ok! I will pick one of them up!
What is this card?
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
好！我要拿起其中一张了！
这张是什么卡片？

scripts.text: Poring
scripts.translation: 波利

scripts.text: Angeling
scripts.translation: 天使波利

scripts.text: Ghostring
scripts.translation: 幽灵波利

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmmm, I think it is the {1} Card!

[House Ghost]
Ok, time to find out!
One! Two! Three!!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
好，是时候揭晓答案了！
一！二！三！！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Huuu...
Better luck next time!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
呼...
下次再加油吧！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
You are better than I thought.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
你比我想象的要厉害呢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was not thinking correctly! Let's do it again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我刚才没想清楚！我们再来一次吧！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Huhu, ok. Let's do it again?
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
呼呼，好吧。我们再来一次？

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ah, it was fun. It has been a long time since I've been able to play a game like that.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
啊，真有趣。好久没有玩过这样的游戏了。

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
As promised, I will be quiet now. Thank you for playing with me.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
说到做到，我现在会安静下来的。谢谢你陪我玩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh and by the way, I have a present for you!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对了，顺便说一句，我有礼物要送给你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said you like milk. Here, take this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你说你喜欢牛奶。来，拿着这个。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You said you like milk. Here, take.. Eh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你说你喜欢牛奶。来，拿...咦？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W, where is this? Wait here. I will bring it soon!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，这是哪里？你在这里等一下。我马上拿来！！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Ah, wow!! Can I have this?
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
啊，哇！！我可以收下这个吗？

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
Thank you so much!!
I promise I wil be quiet now. I will be the acting guardian for this house!
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
太感谢您了！！
我保证现在会安静下来。我会担任这座房子的守护灵！

scripts.text:
[House Ghost]
I will never forget your kindness of entertaining me.
scripts.translation:
[屋中幽灵]
我会永远铭记您陪我玩的这份好意。

scripts.text:

A broom from Payon is the best!
scripts.translation:

斐扬产的扫帚是最好的！

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
It is so good that even ghosts want only a Payon broom.
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
它好得连幽灵都只想要斐扬产的扫帚。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to buy a broom.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想买一把扫帚。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
Oh, you are a guest. Yes, you need a broom?
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
哦，你是客人。是的，你需要一把扫帚？

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
But, I have no broom. Ghosts stole all my newly made brooms. I was pleased because they were nice even for ghosts. But...
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
但是，我没有扫帚了。幽灵把我新做的扫帚都偷走了。我本来很高兴，因为那些扫帚做得很好，连幽灵都喜欢。但是...

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
My son went to their place to get back the brooms, but he failed since the ghosts tricked him.
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
我的儿子去他们那里想把扫帚拿回来，但失败了，因为幽灵骗了他。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
Ah.. What should I do...
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
啊...我该怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
There are ghosts inside the dungeon of Payon. There is a tree there where the ghosts is hiding.
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
斐扬的地下城里有一些幽灵。那里有一棵树，幽灵们就藏在树里。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
My son went to their place to get back the brooms, but he failed since the ghosts tricked him.
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
我的儿子去他们那里想把扫帚拿回来，但失败了，因为幽灵骗了他。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
Ah.. What should I do...
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
啊...我该怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
Ah, you have taken them back. You are a great adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
啊，你把它们拿回来了。你真是一位伟大的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
You can have that broom. I believe it is its destiny.
scripts.translation:
[扫帚婆婆]
这把扫帚你可以拿走了。我相信这是它的命运。

scripts.text:
[Broom Grandma]
A broom from Payon is the best!

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Errr, a human? What are you doing here? Do you want to play with me?
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
呃...人类？你在这里做什么？想跟我玩吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Return the broom.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
把扫帚还给我。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhuhu, if you want it, you must give me the correct answers to my questions!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
库呼呼呼，如果你想要的话，就必须回答我的问题！

scripts.text: Ok, ask me!
scripts.translation: 好，问吧！

scripts.text: No, just give it to me!
scripts.translation: 不，直接给我！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
What!? You are rude to ask for what you want by doing nothing!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
什么？什么都不做就想要东西，太无礼了！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Get away! You must be punished!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
走开！你必须受到惩罚！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhu, you a cool kid?!
I like a person confident as talented. Let's begin the test!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
库呼呼，你是个酷小孩吗？！
我喜欢自信又天才的人。让我们开始测试吧！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Eh.. Let's see. This will be a good start! Let's get started if you are ready!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
呃...让我看看。这会是好的开始！如果你准备好了，我们就开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
First question. Listen to me carefully and answer the question!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
第一个问题。仔细听我说，然后回答问题！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kafra sisters had a race. Listen to what they say and guess their ranking in the race. Understand?
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
卡普拉姐妹们进行了一场比赛。听她们说的话，猜猜她们在比赛中的排名。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ok, then, listen to them.
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
好，那么，听她们说。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Roxie]
I am not good at running but Jasmine won over me and I won over Blossom.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 洛克茜]
我不擅长跑步，但贾丝敏赢了我，而我赢了布洛森。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Blossom]
I think that the smaller you are, the less the air disturbs you. Curly Sue was so fast that I couldn't follow her.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 布洛森]
我觉得你越小，空气阻力就越小。卷毛苏跑得那么快，我根本追不上她。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Jasmine]
I won over Pavianne, but not Curly Sue. Huhu.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 贾丝敏]
我赢了狄波罗太，但没有赢卷毛苏。呼呼。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Curly Sue]
Wohuhu, it was difficult to race with the fast runners. Anyway, I am pleased to win over Roxie!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 卷毛苏]
呜呼呼，和跑得快的选手比赛真难。不过，我很高兴赢了洛克茜！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Pavianne]
...I wasn't the last one even though Roxie won over me...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 狄波罗太]
...虽然被洛克茜超过了，但我并不是最后一名...

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ok then, who was the first?!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
那么，谁是第一名？！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Who was the second?
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
谁是第二名？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Who was the third?
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
谁是第三名？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
And then who was the forth?
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
那么，谁是第四名？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
And who was the last?!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
谁是最后一名？！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ho, you are good!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
呵，你很不错嘛！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]

[幽灵树]
啊，你错了，错了！
你真的以为这样就能拿回扫帚吗？

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ok, let's see if you are good next time.
Gear yourself up!

[幽灵树]
好吧，让我们看看下次你表现如何。
做好准备！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was not thinking correctly! I will try it again!

[{0}]

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
The second question. Listen carefully and answer!

[幽灵树]
第二个问题。仔细听好并回答！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
One day, you, {0}, upgraded your 'Hat of the Sun God', your ancestral treasure.

有一天，你，{0}，升级了你的传家宝“太阳神头盔”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[Ghost Tree]
Shut up! Listen to me!
While Aragam, Antonio, Hermanthorn, and Holgren, 4 blacksmiths, upgraded the 'Hat of the Sun God' in turn, it was broken!

[幽灵树]
闭嘴！听我说！
当阿拉甘、安东尼奥、赫曼索恩和霍尔格伦这四位铁匠轮流升级“太阳神头盔”时，它坏了！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
The stauts of 'Hat of the Sun God' was +7. Here, you guess who broke it!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
“太阳神头盔”的状态是+7。来，猜猜是谁弄坏的！

scripts.text:
[Aragam]

[阿拉甘]

scripts.text:
[Antonio]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Hermanthorn]
Hogren worked after me.
scripts.translation:
[赫曼索恩]
霍尔格伦是在我之后工作的。

scripts.text:
[Holgren]
I did it after Aragam!
scripts.translation:
[霍尔格伦]
我是在阿拉甘之后做的！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Have you heard all of them? Who broke the 'Hat of the Sun God'?!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
你们都听完了吗？到底是谁弄坏了“太阳神头盔”？！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
You are wrong, wrong!
Look at this. In this way, it will take you a million years to take them back!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
你错了，大错特错！
看看这个。照这样下去，你要花上百万年才能把它们拿回来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was not thinking correctly!!!
Again, again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我刚才没想清楚！！！
再来一次，再来一次！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhu, Ok then. You should do better next time!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
库呼呼，好吧。下次你应该表现得更出色一些！

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]

[幽灵树]

[Ghost Tree]
Cast 3 times if you win once, I will give you what you want.
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
掷三次，只要赢一次，我就给你想要的东西。

[{0}]
Ok! I will do it!

[{0}]

I cast first.

[幽灵树]

[{0}]

[Ghost Tree]
You seem lucky...

[幽灵树]
你似乎很幸运...

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Ah. I lost, but it was fun.
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
For the fun play, I will give the broom to you as promised.
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
为了这场有趣的对局，我会如约把扫帚送给你。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
I can say that you are fun. If possible, play with me again. And take them.
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
不得不说，你很有趣。如果可能的话，请再和我玩一次。这些也请收下。

scripts.text:
[Ghost Tree]
Kuhuhu, nobody is worse than you. Remember that you have to win over me to get what you want
scripts.translation:
[幽灵树]
库呼呼，没有人比你更差劲了。记住，想要得到你想要的东西，就必须赢过我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was not what I am! Let's do it again!

[{0}]
